name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.AlgebraicDifferentialInvariants1923.map_sum_mul_of_map_mul
statement:
theorem map_sum_mul_of_map_mul
    (ρ : R →+ R) (s : Finset ι) (coefficient generator : ι → R)
    (hρ_mul : ∀ i ∈ s,
      ρ (coefficient i * generator i) = ρ (coefficient i) * generator i) :
    ρ (∑ i ∈ s, coefficient i * generator i) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, ρ (coefficient i) * generator i
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  exact hρ_mul i hi

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.AlgebraicDifferentialInvariants1923.replace_coefficients_by_retraction
statement:
theorem replace_coefficients_by_retraction
    (Invariant : R → Prop) (ρ : R →+ R) (s : Finset ι)
    (target : R) (coefficient generator : ι → R)
    (hfix : ∀ x, Invariant x → ρ x = x)
    (hρ_mul : ∀ a j, Invariant j → ρ (a * j) = ρ a * j)
    (htarget : Invariant target)
    (hgenerator : ∀ i ∈ s, Invariant (generator i))
    (hidentity : target = ∑ i ∈ s, coefficient i * generator i) :
    target = ∑ i ∈ s, ρ (coefficient i) * generator i
proof:
:= by
  calc
    target = ρ target := (hfix target htarget).symm
    _ = ρ (∑ i ∈ s, coefficient i * generator i) := congrArg ρ hidentity
    _ = ∑ i ∈ s, ρ (coefficient i) * generator i :=
      map_sum_mul_of_map_mul ρ s coefficient generator fun i hi ↦
        hρ_mul (coefficient i) (generator i) (hgenerator i hi)

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.AlgebraicDifferentialInvariants1923.exists_invariant_coefficients_of_retraction
statement:
theorem exists_invariant_coefficients_of_retraction
    (Invariant : R → Prop) (ρ : R →+ R) (s : Finset ι)
    (target : R) (coefficient generator : ι → R)
    (hfix : ∀ x, Invariant x → ρ x = x)
    (hrange : ∀ x, Invariant (ρ x))
    (hρ_mul : ∀ a j, Invariant j → ρ (a * j) = ρ a * j)
    (htarget : Invariant target)
    (hgenerator : ∀ i ∈ s, Invariant (generator i))
    (hidentity : target = ∑ i ∈ s, coefficient i * generator i) :
    ∃ invariantCoefficient : ι → R,
      (∀ i ∈ s, Invariant (invariantCoefficient i)) ∧
      target = ∑ i ∈ s, invariantCoefficient i * generator i
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ ρ (coefficient i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i _
    exact hrange (coefficient i)
  · exact replace_coefficients_by_retraction Invariant ρ s target coefficient generator
      hfix hρ_mul htarget hgenerator hidentity

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.AlgebraicDifferentialInvariants1923.exists_uniformExponent_of_le_radical
statement:
theorem exists_uniformExponent_of_le_radical
    {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (a : Ideal R) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ b : Ideal R, b ≤ a.radical → b ^ r ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ :=
    a.exists_radical_pow_le_of_fg a.radical.fg_of_isNoetherianRing
  refine ⟨r + 1, Nat.zero_lt_succ r, fun b hba ↦ ?_⟩
  exact (Ideal.pow_right_mono hba (r + 1)).trans <|
    (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := a.radical) r.le_succ).trans hr

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.AlgebraicDifferentialInvariants1923.exists_uniformExponent_of_vanishingOn_zeroLocus
statement:
theorem exists_uniformExponent_of_vanishingOn_zeroLocus
    (a : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ b : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k),
      (∀ f ∈ b, ∀ x ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus K a, MvPolynomial.aeval x f = 0) →
        b ^ r ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hrpos, hr⟩ := exists_uniformExponent_of_le_radical a
  refine ⟨r, hrpos, fun b hb ↦ hr b ?_⟩
  have hba : b ≤ a.radical := by
    rw [← MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical (K := K) a]
    intro f hf x hx
    exact hb f hf x hx
  exact hba

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.EliminationIdealTheorySurvey1924.aeval_genericZero_eq_algebraMap_mk
statement:
theorem aeval_genericZero_eq_algebraMap_mk
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ P)) [I.IsPrime] (f : MvPolynomial σ P) :
    MvPolynomial.aeval (genericZero I) f =
      algebraMap (CoordinateRing I) (GenericZeroField I) (Ideal.Quotient.mk I f)
proof:
:= by
  let q : MvPolynomial σ P →ₐ[P] CoordinateRing I := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ P I
  let j : CoordinateRing I →ₐ[P] GenericZeroField I :=
    IsScalarTower.toAlgHom P (CoordinateRing I) (GenericZeroField I)
  have h_eval : MvPolynomial.aeval (genericZero I) = j.comp q := by
    ext i
    simp [genericZero, q, j]
  simp only [h_eval, AlgHom.comp_apply, q, j, IsScalarTower.toAlgHom_apply,
    Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.EliminationIdealTheorySurvey1924.intermediateField_adjoin_range_genericZero_eq_top
statement:
theorem intermediateField_adjoin_range_genericZero_eq_top
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ P)) [I.IsPrime] :
    IntermediateField.adjoin P (Set.range (genericZero I)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let F : IntermediateField P (GenericZeroField I) :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin P (Set.range (genericZero I))
  have hcoord (i : σ) : genericZero I i ∈ F :=
    IntermediateField.subset_adjoin P _ (Set.mem_range_self i)
  have heval (f : MvPolynomial σ P) : MvPolynomial.aeval (genericZero I) f ∈ F := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_def]
    apply MvPolynomial.eval₂_mem
    · intro n hn
      exact F.algebraMap_mem _
    · exact fun i ↦ hcoord i
  have hquotient (x : CoordinateRing I) :
      algebraMap (CoordinateRing I) (GenericZeroField I) x ∈ F := by
    obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    rw [← aeval_genericZero_eq_algebraMap_mk]
    exact heval f
  change F = ⊤
  apply top_unique
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨x, y, hy, hxy⟩ :=
    IsFractionRing.div_surjective (CoordinateRing I) z
  rw [← hxy]
  exact F.div_mem (hquotient x) (hquotient y)

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.EliminationIdealTheorySurvey1924.isAlgebraic_algebraAdjoin_of_intermediateField_adjoin_eq_top
statement:
private theorem isAlgebraic_algebraAdjoin_of_intermediateField_adjoin_eq_top
    {F E : Type*} [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E]
    (S : Set E) (hS : IntermediateField.adjoin F S = ⊤) :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic (Algebra.adjoin F S) E
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  let y : IntermediateField.adjoin F S := ⟨x, by simpa [hS]⟩
  have hy : IsAlgebraic (Algebra.adjoin F S) y :=
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic y
  have hz := hy.algHom
    (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom (Algebra.adjoin F S) (IntermediateField.adjoin F S) E)
  simpa [y, IsScalarTower.toAlgHom_apply] using hz

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.EliminationIdealTheorySurvey1924.trdeg_genericZeroField_le_cardinalMk_range
statement:
theorem trdeg_genericZeroField_le_cardinalMk_range
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ P)) [I.IsPrime] :
    Algebra.trdeg P (GenericZeroField I) ≤ Cardinal.mk (Set.range (genericZero I))
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set (GenericZeroField I) := Set.range (genericZero I)
  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (Algebra.adjoin P S) (GenericZeroField I) :=
    isAlgebraic_algebraAdjoin_of_intermediateField_adjoin_eq_top S
      (intermediateField_adjoin_range_genericZero_eq_top I)
  exact Algebra.IsAlgebraic.trdeg_le_cardinalMk P S

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.EliminationIdealTheorySurvey1924.trdeg_genericZeroField_fin_le
proof:
:= by
  have htr := trdeg_genericZeroField_le_cardinalMk_range I
  have h := (Cardinal.lift_le.mpr htr).trans
    (Cardinal.mk_range_le_lift (f := genericZero I))
  simpa using h

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.EliminationIdealTheorySurvey1924.trdeg_genericZeroField_fin_lt_of_ne_bot
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hlt
  have hnle : (n : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg P (GenericZeroField I) :=
    not_lt.mp hlt
  let S : Set (GenericZeroField I) := Set.range (genericZero I)
  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (Algebra.adjoin P S) (GenericZeroField I) :=
    isAlgebraic_algebraAdjoin_of_intermediateField_adjoin_eq_top S
      (intermediateField_adjoin_range_genericZero_eq_top I)
  have hbasis : IsTranscendenceBasis P (genericZero I) :=
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isTranscendenceBasis_of_lift_le_trdeg_of_finite
      P (genericZero I) (by simpa using hnle)
  obtain ⟨f, hfI, hfbot⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt (bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr hI)
  have hfne : f ≠ 0 := by simpa using hfbot
  have heval : MvPolynomial.aeval (genericZero I) f = 0 := by
    rw [aeval_genericZero_eq_algebraMap_mk,
      Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hfI, map_zero]
  have hinj : Function.Injective (MvPolynomial.aeval (genericZero I)) :=
    algebraicIndependent_iff_injective_aeval.mp hbasis.1
  exact hfne (hinj (by simpa using heval))

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.EliminationIdealTheorySurvey1924.aeval_genericZero_eq_zero_iff_mem
statement:
theorem aeval_genericZero_eq_zero_iff_mem (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ P)) [I.IsPrime]
    (f : MvPolynomial σ P) :
    MvPolynomial.aeval (genericZero I) f = 0 ↔ f ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  let q : MvPolynomial σ P →ₐ[P] CoordinateRing I := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ P I
  let j : CoordinateRing I →ₐ[P] GenericZeroField I :=
    IsScalarTower.toAlgHom P (CoordinateRing I) (GenericZeroField I)
  have h_eval : MvPolynomial.aeval (genericZero I) = j.comp q := by
    ext i
    simp [genericZero, q, j]
  constructor
  · intro hf
    have hmap : algebraMap (CoordinateRing I) (GenericZeroField I)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk I f) = 0 := by
      simpa only [h_eval, AlgHom.comp_apply, q, j, IsScalarTower.toAlgHom_apply,
        Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk] using hf
    have hquot : Ideal.Quotient.mk I f = 0 :=
      IsFractionRing.injective (CoordinateRing I) (GenericZeroField I) (by simpa using hmap)
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp hquot
  · intro hf
    have hquot : Ideal.Quotient.mk I f = 0 :=
      Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hf
    have hmap : algebraMap (CoordinateRing I) (GenericZeroField I)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk I f) = 0 := by
      rw [hquot, map_zero]
    simpa only [h_eval, AlgHom.comp_apply, q, j, IsScalarTower.toAlgHom_apply,
      Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk] using hmap

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.EliminationIdealTheorySurvey1924.aeval_genericZero_fin_eq_zero_iff_mem
proof:
:=
  aeval_genericZero_eq_zero_iff_mem I f

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.ModularInvariants1926.subalgebra_finiteType_of_fixedPoints_le
statement:
theorem subalgebra_finiteType_of_fixedPoints_le
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [Algebra.FiniteType A B]
    (C : Subalgebra A B) (hC : FixedPoints.subalgebra A B G ≤ C) :
    Algebra.FiniteType A C
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra.IsInvariant C B G :=
    ⟨fun b hb ↦ ⟨⟨b, hC hb⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  letI : Algebra.IsIntegral C B := Algebra.IsInvariant.isIntegral C B G
  letI : Algebra.FiniteType C B :=
    Algebra.FiniteType.of_restrictScalars_finiteType A C B
  letI : Module.Finite C B := Algebra.IsIntegral.finite
  exact ⟨fg_of_fg_of_fg A C B
    (‹Algebra.FiniteType A B›.out)
    Module.Finite.fg_top (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective C B)⟩

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.DedekindTheory1927.dimensionLEOne_of_artinian_nonzero_quotients
statement:
theorem dimensionLEOne_of_artinian_nonzero_quotients
    (h : ∀ I : Ideal R, I ≠ ⊥ → IsArtinianRing (R ⧸ I)) :
    Ring.DimensionLEOne R where
  maximalOfPrime
proof:
:= by
    intro p hp hprime
    letI : p.IsPrime := hprime
    letI : IsArtinianRing (R ⧸ p) := h p hp
    exact Ideal.Quotient.maximal_of_isField p
      (IsArtinianRing.isField_of_isDomain (R ⧸ p))

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.DedekindTheory1927.isArtinianRing_quotient_of_dimensionLEOne
statement:
theorem isArtinianRing_quotient_of_dimensionLEOne
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [Ring.DimensionLEOne R]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≠ ⊥) : IsArtinianRing (R ⧸ I)
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsNoetherianRing (R ⧸ I) :=
    isNoetherianRing_of_surjective R (R ⧸ I) (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  haveI : Ring.KrullDimLE 0 (R ⧸ I) :=
    (Ideal.krullDimLE_zero_quotient_iff_forall_minimalPrimes_isMaximal).2
      fun J hJ ↦ hJ.1.1.isMaximal <| by
        intro hJbot
        apply hI
        apply le_bot_iff.mp
        simpa [hJbot] using hJ.1.2
  exact IsNoetherianRing.isArtinianRing_of_krullDimLE_zero

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.DedekindTheory1927.artinian_nonzero_quotients_iff_dimensionLEOne
statement:
theorem artinian_nonzero_quotients_iff_dimensionLEOne
    [IsNoetherianRing R] :
    (∀ I : Ideal R, I ≠ ⊥ → IsArtinianRing (R ⧸ I)) ↔
      Ring.DimensionLEOne R
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact dimensionLEOne_of_artinian_nonzero_quotients
  · intro h
    letI : Ring.DimensionLEOne R := h
    exact isArtinianRing_quotient_of_dimensionLEOne

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.SeriesExpansion1920.sub_mem_relationIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem sub_mem_relationIdeal_iff
    (f : σ → MvPolynomial τ R) (F Phi : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    F - Phi ∈ relationIdeal f ↔
      MvPolynomial.bind₁ f F = MvPolynomial.bind₁ f Phi
proof:
:= by
  change F - Phi ∈ RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.bind₁ f).toRingHom ↔
    (MvPolynomial.bind₁ f).toRingHom F =
      (MvPolynomial.bind₁ f).toRingHom Phi
  exact RingHom.sub_mem_ker_iff (MvPolynomial.bind₁ f).toRingHom

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.AbstractIdealTheory1924.isDedekindDomain_iff_integrallyClosed_and_artinianQuotients
statement:
theorem isDedekindDomain_iff_integrallyClosed_and_artinianQuotients :
    IsDedekindDomain R ↔
      IsIntegrallyClosed R ∧
        ∀ I : Ideal R, I ≠ ⊥ → IsArtinianRing (R ⧸ I)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    letI : IsDedekindDomain R := h
    exact ⟨inferInstance, isArtinianRing_quotient_of_dimensionLEOne⟩
  · rintro ⟨hclosed, hquot⟩
    letI : IsIntegrallyClosed R := hclosed
    letI : Ring.DimensionLEOne R :=
      dimensionLEOne_of_artinian_nonzero_quotients hquot
    exact (isDedekindDomain_iff R (FractionRing R)).2
      ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
        (isIntegrallyClosed_iff (FractionRing R)).mp inferInstance⟩

statement:

proof:

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.coefficientModule_mul_le_mul_coefficientModule
statement:
theorem coefficientModule_mul_le_mul_coefficientModule (f g : R[X]) :
    coefficientModule (A := A) (f * g) ≤
      coefficientModule (A := A) f * coefficientModule (A := A) g
proof:
:= by
  rw [coefficientModule, Submodule.span_le]
  simp only [Set.subset_def, Finset.mem_coe, Polynomial.mem_coeffs_iff]
  rintro r ⟨n, -, rfl⟩
  simp [Polynomial.coeff_mul, Submodule.sum_mem, Submodule.mul_mem_mul,
    coeff_mem_coefficientModule]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.coefficientModule_mul_C_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · simpa using coefficientModule_mul_le_mul_coefficientModule (A := A) f (C b)
  · change
      Submodule.span A (f.coeffs : Set R) * Submodule.span A ({b} : Set R) ≤
        coefficientModule (A := A) (f * C b)
    rw [Submodule.span_mul_span, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro x ⟨a, ha, c, hc, rfl⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hc
    subst c
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Polynomial.mem_coeffs_iff] at ha
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := ha
    simpa [Polynomial.coeff_mul_C] using
      coeff_mem_coefficientModule (A := A) (f * C b) i

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.coefficientModule_le_erase_sup_span
statement:
theorem coefficientModule_le_erase_sup_span (g : R[X]) (m : ℕ) :
    coefficientModule (A := A) g ≤
      coefficientModule (A := A) (g.erase m) ⊔
        Submodule.span A {g.coeff m}
proof:
:= by
  rw [coefficientModule, Submodule.span_le]
  intro x hx
  simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Polynomial.mem_coeffs_iff] at hx
  obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := hx
  by_cases hi : i = m
  · subst i
    exact (show Submodule.span A {g.coeff m} ≤
      coefficientModule (A := A) (g.erase m) ⊔
        Submodule.span A {g.coeff m} from le_sup_right)
      (Submodule.subset_span (by simp))
  · apply (show coefficientModule (A := A) (g.erase m) ≤
      coefficientModule (A := A) (g.erase m) ⊔
        Submodule.span A {g.coeff m} from le_sup_left)
    have hmem := coeff_mem_coefficientModule (A := A) (g.erase m) i
    simpa [Polynomial.coeff_erase, hi] using hmem

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.coefficientModule_mul_erase_le
statement:
theorem coefficientModule_mul_erase_le (f g : R[X]) (m : ℕ) :
    coefficientModule (A := A) (f * g.erase m) ≤
      coefficientModule (A := A) (f * g) ⊔
        coefficientModule (A := A) f * Submodule.span A {g.coeff m}
proof:
:= by
  let t : R[X] := monomial m (g.coeff m)
  have hpoly : f * g.erase m + f * t = f * g := by
    rw [← mul_add]
    congr 1
    simpa [t, add_comm] using g.monomial_add_erase m
  rw [coefficientModule, Submodule.span_le]
  intro x hx
  simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Polynomial.mem_coeffs_iff] at hx
  obtain ⟨k, -, rfl⟩ := hx
  have hcoeff := congrArg (fun p : R[X] ↦ p.coeff k) hpoly
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_add] at hcoeff
  have hleft : (f * g).coeff k ∈
      coefficientModule (A := A) (f * g) ⊔
        coefficientModule (A := A) f * Submodule.span A {g.coeff m} :=
    (show coefficientModule (A := A) (f * g) ≤
      coefficientModule (A := A) (f * g) ⊔
        coefficientModule (A := A) f * Submodule.span A {g.coeff m} from
          le_sup_left)
      (coeff_mem_coefficientModule (A := A) (f * g) k)
  have hterm0 :=
    coefficientModule_mul_le_mul_coefficientModule (A := A) f t
      (coeff_mem_coefficientModule (A := A) (f * t) k)
  have hterm : (f * t).coeff k ∈
      coefficientModule (A := A) (f * g) ⊔
        coefficientModule (A := A) f * Submodule.span A {g.coeff m} := by
    apply (show coefficientModule (A := A) f * Submodule.span A {g.coeff m} ≤
      coefficientModule (A := A) (f * g) ⊔
        coefficientModule (A := A) f * Submodule.span A {g.coeff m} from
          le_sup_right)
    simpa [t] using hterm0
  rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq hcoeff]
  exact (coefficientModule (A := A) (f * g) ⊔
    coefficientModule (A := A) f * Submodule.span A {g.coeff m}).sub_mem
      hleft hterm

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.span_singleton_mul_le_iff
statement:
theorem span_singleton_mul_le_iff {x : R} {M N : Submodule A R} :
    Submodule.span A {x} * M ≤ N ↔ ∀ y ∈ M, x * y ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h y hy
    exact h (Submodule.mul_mem_mul (Submodule.subset_span (by simp)) hy)
  · intro h y hy
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hxz⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton_mul.mp hy
    rw [← hxz]
    exact h z hz

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.coefficientModule_mul_le_of_coefficients
statement:
theorem coefficientModule_mul_le_of_coefficients
    (f : R[X]) (M K : Submodule A R)
    (h : ∀ i : ℕ, Submodule.span A {f.coeff i} * M ≤ K) :
    coefficientModule (A := A) f * M ≤ K
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.mul_le]
  intro a ha z hz
  change a ∈ Submodule.span A (f.coeffs : Set R) at ha
  induction ha using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem a ha =>
      simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Polynomial.mem_coeffs_iff] at ha
      obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := ha
      exact (span_singleton_mul_le_iff.mp (h i)) z hz
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
      rw [add_mul]
      exact K.add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx =>
      rw [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
      exact K.smul_mem c hx

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.dedekindMertens_coefficientModule_hard_bound
statement:
theorem dedekindMertens_coefficientModule_hard_bound
    (f g : R[X]) (m : ℕ) (hg : g.natDegree ≤ m) :
    coefficientModule (A := A) f ^ (m + 1) *
        coefficientModule (A := A) g ≤
      coefficientModule (A := A) f ^ m *
        coefficientModule (A := A) (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing g with
  | zero =>
      have hg0 : g.natDegree = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hg
      rw [Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hg0]
      simp [coefficientModule_mul_C_eq]
  | succ n ih =>
      let m := n + 1
      let F : Submodule A R := coefficientModule (A := A) f
      let Q : Submodule A R := coefficientModule (A := A) (g.erase m)
      let b : R := g.coeff m
      let H : Submodule A R := coefficientModule (A := A) (f * g)
      let K : Submodule A R := F ^ m * H
      have hm : m = n + 1 := rfl
      have hqdeg : (g.erase m).natDegree ≤ n := by
        rw [Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero]
        intro j hj
        rw [Polynomial.coeff_erase]
        split_ifs with heq
        · rfl
        · apply g.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt
          have hmj : m < j := by
            have hmle : m ≤ j := by
              simpa [m] using (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hj)
            exact lt_of_le_of_ne hmle (fun h ↦ heq h.symm)
          exact hg.trans_lt (by simpa [m] using hmj)
      have hrec : F ^ m * Q ≤
          F ^ n * coefficientModule (A := A) (f * g.erase m) := by
        simpa [F, Q, m] using ih (g.erase m) hqdeg
      have herase : coefficientModule (A := A) (f * g.erase m) ≤
          H ⊔ F * Submodule.span A {b} := by
        simpa [F, H, b] using coefficientModule_mul_erase_le (A := A) f g m

      let P : ℕ → Prop := fun i ↦
        Submodule.span A {f.coeff i} * (F ^ m * Q) ≤ K
      let B : ℕ → Prop := fun i ↦
        Submodule.span A {f.coeff i * b} * F ^ m ≤ K
      let Tail : ℕ → Prop := fun i ↦
        ∀ j, i ≤ j → P j ∧ B j

      have htail_top : Tail (f.natDegree + 1) := by
        intro j hj
        have hzero : f.coeff j = 0 :=
          f.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt
            ((Nat.lt_succ_self f.natDegree).trans_le hj)
        simp [P, B, hzero]

      have htail_step : ∀ i < f.natDegree + 1,
          Tail (i + 1) → Tail i := by
        intro i hi htail j hij
        by_cases hji : j = i
        · subst j
          have hB : B i := by
            change Submodule.span A {f.coeff i * b} * F ^ m ≤ K
            rw [span_singleton_mul_le_iff]
            intro u hu
            let S := (Finset.antidiagonal (i + m)).erase (i, m)
            have himem : (i, m) ∈ Finset.antidiagonal (i + m) := by
              simp
            have hconv : (f * g).coeff (i + m) =
                f.coeff i * b +
                  ∑ p ∈ S, f.coeff p.1 * g.coeff p.2 := by
              rw [Polynomial.coeff_mul,
                ← Finset.insert_erase himem,
                Finset.sum_insert (Finset.notMem_erase _ _)]
            have hmain : (f * g).coeff (i + m) * u ∈ K := by
              simpa [mul_comm] using Submodule.mul_mem_mul hu
                (coeff_mem_coefficientModule (A := A) (f * g) (i + m))
            have hsum :
                (∑ p ∈ S, f.coeff p.1 * g.coeff p.2) * u ∈ K := by
              rw [Finset.sum_mul]
              apply K.sum_mem
              intro p hp
              rw [Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
              rcases p with ⟨x, y⟩
              by_cases hym : m < y
              · have hgy : g.coeff y = 0 :=
                  g.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt
                    (hg.trans_lt (by simpa [m] using hym))
                simp [hgy]
              · have hymle : y ≤ m := Nat.le_of_not_gt hym
                have hyne : y ≠ m := by
                  intro hy
                  apply hp.1
                  have hx : x = i := by
                    simpa [hy] using hp.2
                  simp [hx, hy]
                have hylt : y < m := lt_of_le_of_ne hymle hyne
                have hix : i < x := by
                  by_contra hix
                  have hbad : x + y < i + m :=
                    Nat.add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_of_not_gt hix) hylt
                  rw [hp.2] at hbad
                  exact (Nat.lt_irrefl _ hbad)
                have hqcoeff : g.coeff y ∈ Q := by
                  have hmem :=
                    coeff_mem_coefficientModule (A := A) (g.erase m) y
                  simpa [Q, Polynomial.coeff_erase, hyne] using hmem
                have hPx := (htail x (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hix)).1
                have hPx' := span_singleton_mul_le_iff.mp hPx
                have huz : u * g.coeff y ∈ F ^ m * Q :=
                  Submodule.mul_mem_mul hu hqcoeff
                convert hPx' (u * g.coeff y) huz using 1
                all_goals ring
            rw [hconv] at hmain
            convert K.sub_mem hmain hsum using 1
            all_goals ring
          have hP : P i := by
            change Submodule.span A {f.coeff i} * (F ^ m * Q) ≤ K
            rw [span_singleton_mul_le_iff]
            intro z hz
            have hz' : z ∈
                F ^ n * coefficientModule (A := A) (f * g.erase m) := hrec hz
            have hmul : Submodule.span A {f.coeff i} *
                (F ^ n * coefficientModule (A := A) (f * g.erase m)) ≤ K := by
              calc
                Submodule.span A {f.coeff i} *
                    (F ^ n * coefficientModule (A := A) (f * g.erase m))
                    ≤ Submodule.span A {f.coeff i} *
                        (F ^ n * (H ⊔ F * Submodule.span A {b})) :=
                  mul_le_mul' le_rfl (mul_le_mul' le_rfl herase)
                _ = (Submodule.span A {f.coeff i} * (F ^ n * H)) ⊔
                    (Submodule.span A {f.coeff i} *
                      (F ^ n * (F * Submodule.span A {b}))) := by
                  rw [Submodule.mul_sup, Submodule.mul_sup]
                _ ≤ K := by
                  apply sup_le
                  · calc
                      Submodule.span A {f.coeff i} * (F ^ n * H)
                          = (Submodule.span A {f.coeff i} * F ^ n) * H := by
                            rw [mul_assoc]
                      _ ≤ (F * F ^ n) * H :=
                        mul_le_mul'
                          (mul_le_mul'
                            (Submodule.span_le.mpr
                              (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr
                                (coeff_mem_coefficientModule (A := A) f i)))
                            le_rfl)
                          le_rfl
                      _ = K := by
                        simp only [K, hm]
                        rw [pow_succ]
                        ac_rfl
                  · have hrew :
                        Submodule.span A {f.coeff i} *
                            (F ^ n * (F * Submodule.span A {b})) =
                          Submodule.span A {f.coeff i * b} * F ^ m := by
                        have hspan :
                            Submodule.span A {f.coeff i} *
                                Submodule.span A {b} =
                              Submodule.span A {f.coeff i * b} := by
                          rw [Submodule.span_mul_span]
                          simp
                        simp only [hm]
                        rw [pow_succ]
                        calc
                          Submodule.span A {f.coeff i} *
                                (F ^ n * (F * Submodule.span A {b})) =
                              (Submodule.span A {f.coeff i} *
                                Submodule.span A {b}) * (F ^ n * F) := by
                            ac_rfl
                          _ = Submodule.span A {f.coeff i * b} *
                                (F ^ n * F) := by rw [hspan]
                    rw [hrew]
                    exact hB
            exact (span_singleton_mul_le_iff.mp hmul) z hz'
          exact ⟨hP, hB⟩
        · have hijlt : i < j := lt_of_le_of_ne hij (Ne.symm hji)
          exact htail j (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hijlt)

      have htail_zero : Tail 0 :=
        Nat.decreasingInduction
          (n := f.natDegree + 1)
          (fun i hi htail ↦ htail_step i hi htail)
          htail_top (Nat.zero_le _)
      have hall (i : ℕ) : P i ∧ B i := htail_zero i (Nat.zero_le i)

      have hQ : F * (F ^ m * Q) ≤ K := by
        change coefficientModule (A := A) f * (F ^ m * Q) ≤ K
        exact coefficientModule_mul_le_of_coefficients f (F ^ m * Q) K
          (fun i ↦ (hall i).1)

      have hb' : F * (Submodule.span A {b} * F ^ m) ≤ K := by
        change coefficientModule (A := A) f *
          (Submodule.span A {b} * F ^ m) ≤ K
        apply coefficientModule_mul_le_of_coefficients f
          (Submodule.span A {b} * F ^ m) K
        intro i
        rw [span_singleton_mul_le_iff]
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton_mul.mp hz
        have hi := span_singleton_mul_le_iff.mp (hall i).2 u hu
        convert hi using 1
        all_goals ring
      have hb : (F * Submodule.span A {b}) * F ^ m ≤ K := by
        rw [mul_assoc]
        exact hb'

      have hG : coefficientModule (A := A) g ≤
          Q ⊔ Submodule.span A {b} := by
        simpa [Q, b] using coefficientModule_le_erase_sup_span (A := A) g m
      calc
        coefficientModule (A := A) f ^ (n + 1 + 1) *
              coefficientModule (A := A) g
            ≤ F ^ (m + 1) * (Q ⊔ Submodule.span A {b}) := by
              simpa [F, m] using mul_le_mul' le_rfl hG
        _ = (F ^ (m + 1) * Q) ⊔
              (F ^ (m + 1) * Submodule.span A {b}) := by
              rw [Submodule.mul_sup]
        _ ≤ K := by
          apply sup_le
          · have hrew : F ^ (m + 1) * Q = F * (F ^ m * Q) := by
              rw [pow_succ]
              ac_rfl
            rw [hrew]
            exact hQ
          · have hrew : F ^ (m + 1) * Submodule.span A {b} =
                (F * Submodule.span A {b}) * F ^ m := by
              rw [pow_succ]
              ac_rfl
            rw [hrew]
            exact hb
        _ = coefficientModule (A := A) f ^ (n + 1) *
              coefficientModule (A := A) (f * g) := by
          simp [K, F, H, m]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.dedekindMertens_coefficientModule
statement:
theorem dedekindMertens_coefficientModule (f g : R[X]) :
    coefficientModule (A := A) f ^ (g.natDegree + 1) *
        coefficientModule (A := A) g =
      coefficientModule (A := A) f ^ g.natDegree *
        coefficientModule (A := A) (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact dedekindMertens_coefficientModule_hard_bound f g g.natDegree le_rfl
  · calc
      coefficientModule (A := A) f ^ g.natDegree *
            coefficientModule (A := A) (f * g)
          ≤ coefficientModule (A := A) f ^ g.natDegree *
              (coefficientModule (A := A) f *
                coefficientModule (A := A) g) :=
        mul_le_mul' le_rfl
          (coefficientModule_mul_le_mul_coefficientModule (A := A) f g)
      _ = coefficientModule (A := A) f ^ (g.natDegree + 1) *
            coefficientModule (A := A) g := by
        rw [pow_succ]
        ac_rfl

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.dedekindMertens_module_le_restrictScalars
statement:
theorem dedekindMertens_module_le_restrictScalars
    (I : Ideal S) {A B D : Submodule ℤ S} {q : ℕ}
    (hDM : A ^ q * B = A ^ (q - 1) * D)
    (hD : D ≤ I.restrictScalars ℤ) :
    A ^ q * B ≤ I.restrictScalars ℤ
proof:
:= by
  rw [hDM]
  refine Submodule.mul_le.mpr ?_
  intro a _ha d hd
  exact (Submodule.restrictScalars_mem ℤ I (a * d)).2
    (I.mul_mem_left a
      ((Submodule.restrictScalars_mem ℤ I d).1 (hD hd)))

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.mvPolynomial_coeff_pow_mem_submodule_pow
statement:
theorem mvPolynomial_coeff_pow_mem_submodule_pow
    {U : Type*} (A : Submodule ℤ S) (p : MvPolynomial U S)
    (hp : ∀ d : U →₀ ℕ, p.coeff d ∈ A) (q : ℕ) (d : U →₀ ℕ) :
    (p ^ q).coeff d ∈ A ^ q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction q generalizing d with
  | zero =>
      change MvPolynomial.coeff d (1 : MvPolynomial U S) ∈
        (1 : Submodule ℤ S)
      rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_one]
      split_ifs
      · exact Submodule.one_le.mp le_rfl
      · exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | succ q ih =>
      change MvPolynomial.coeff d (p ^ q * p) ∈ A ^ q * A
      rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_mul]
      exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun x _ =>
        Submodule.mul_mem_mul (ih x.1) (hp x.2)

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.mvPolynomial_pow_mul_C_mem_coefficientExtension
statement:
theorem mvPolynomial_pow_mul_C_mem_coefficientExtension
    {U : Type*} (I : Ideal S) {A B D : Submodule ℤ S} {q : ℕ}
    (hDM : A ^ q * B = A ^ (q - 1) * D)
    (hD : D ≤ I.restrictScalars ℤ)
    (p : MvPolynomial U S)
    (hp : ∀ d : U →₀ ℕ, p.coeff d ∈ A)
    {gamma : S} (hgamma : gamma ∈ B) :
    p ^ q * MvPolynomial.C gamma ∈
      Ideal.map (MvPolynomial.C : S →+* MvPolynomial U S) I
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPolynomial.mem_map_C_iff]
  intro d
  have hmodule :=
    dedekindMertens_module_le_restrictScalars I hDM hD
  have hpow :=
    mvPolynomial_coeff_pow_mem_submodule_pow A p hp q d
  have hcoeff :
      (p ^ q * MvPolynomial.C gamma).coeff d ∈ A ^ q * B := by
    rw [mul_comm (p ^ q) (MvPolynomial.C gamma),
      MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul,
      mul_comm gamma ((p ^ q).coeff d)]
    exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul hpow hgamma
  exact (Submodule.restrictScalars_mem ℤ I _).1 (hmodule hcoeff)

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.Kronecker.weightedExponent_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weightedExponent_apply (base : ℕ) (e : Fin n →₀ ℕ) :
    weightedExponent base e = ∑ i : Fin n, base ^ (i : ℕ) * e i
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.Kronecker.weightedExponent_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weightedExponent_single (base : ℕ) (i : Fin n) (a : ℕ) :
    weightedExponent base (Finsupp.single i a) = base ^ (i : ℕ) * a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [weightedExponent_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp
  · intro j _ hji
    simp [hji]
  · simp

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.Kronecker.ofDigits_ofFn_eq_sum
statement:
private theorem ofDigits_ofFn_eq_sum (base : ℕ) :
    ∀ {m : ℕ} (e : Fin m → ℕ),
      Nat.ofDigits base (List.ofFn e) =
        ∑ i : Fin m, base ^ (i : ℕ) * e i
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
      intro e
      simp
  | succ m ih =>
      intro e
      rw [List.ofFn_succ, Nat.ofDigits_cons, Fin.sum_univ_succ, ih]
      simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_mul, Fin.val_succ]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      simp [pow_succ, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.Kronecker.ofDigits_ofFn_eq_weightedExponent
statement:
theorem ofDigits_ofFn_eq_weightedExponent (base : ℕ) (e : Fin n →₀ ℕ) :
    Nat.ofDigits base (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n => e i) =
      weightedExponent base e
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [weightedExponent_apply] using
    ofDigits_ofFn_eq_sum base (fun i : Fin n => e i)

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.Kronecker.weightedExponent_injective_of_lt_base
statement:
theorem weightedExponent_injective_of_lt_base
    (hbase : 1 < base) {e f : Fin n →₀ ℕ}
    (he : ∀ i, e i < base) (hf : ∀ i, f i < base)
    (hcode : weightedExponent base e = weightedExponent base f) :
    e = f
proof:
:= by
  have hdigits :
      Nat.ofDigits base (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n => e i) =
        Nat.ofDigits base (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n => f i) := by
    calc
      Nat.ofDigits base (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n => e i) =
          weightedExponent base e :=
        ofDigits_ofFn_eq_weightedExponent base e
      _ = weightedExponent base f := hcode
      _ = Nat.ofDigits base (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n => f i) :=
        (ofDigits_ofFn_eq_weightedExponent base f).symm
  have hlists :
      List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => e i) =
        List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => f i) :=
    Nat.ofDigits_inj_of_len_eq hbase (by simp)
      ((List.forall_mem_ofFn_iff).2 he)
      ((List.forall_mem_ofFn_iff).2 hf) hdigits
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro i
  exact congrFun (List.ofFn_inj.mp hlists) i

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.Kronecker.exponent_le_of_mem_support
proof:
:=
  (MvPolynomial.monomial_le_degreeOf i he).trans
    ((MvPolynomial.degreeOf_le_totalDegree p i).trans hdegree)

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.Kronecker.weightedExponent_injOn_support_of_totalDegree_le
statement:
theorem weightedExponent_injOn_support_of_totalDegree_le
    {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R}
    (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ d) (hbase : d < base) :
    Set.InjOn (weightedExponent base) (↑p.support : Set (Fin n →₀ ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  intro e he f hf hcode
  have he' : e ∈ p.support := he
  have hf' : f ∈ p.support := hf
  cases d with
  | zero =>
      apply Finsupp.ext
      intro i
      have hei : e i = 0 :=
        Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero
          (exponent_le_of_mem_support (d := 0) hdegree he' i)
      have hfi : f i = 0 :=
        Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero
          (exponent_le_of_mem_support (d := 0) hdegree hf' i)
      rw [hei, hfi]
  | succ d =>
      apply weightedExponent_injective_of_lt_base
      · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le d)) hbase
      · intro i
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt
          (exponent_le_of_mem_support hdegree he' i) hbase
      · intro i
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt
          (exponent_le_of_mem_support hdegree hf' i) hbase
      · exact hcode

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.Kronecker.kroneckerSubstitution_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kroneckerSubstitution_C (base : ℕ) (a : R) :
    kroneckerSubstitution (R := R) (n := n) base (MvPolynomial.C a) =
      Polynomial.C a
proof:
:= by
  simp [kroneckerSubstitution]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.Kronecker.kroneckerSubstitution_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kroneckerSubstitution_X (base : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
    kroneckerSubstitution (R := R) base (MvPolynomial.X i) =
      Polynomial.X ^ (base ^ (i : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  simp [kroneckerSubstitution]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.Kronecker.kroneckerSubstitution_monomial
statement:
theorem kroneckerSubstitution_monomial (base : ℕ)
    (e : Fin n →₀ ℕ) (a : R) :
    kroneckerSubstitution (R := R) base (MvPolynomial.monomial e a) =
      Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X ^ weightedExponent base e
proof:
:= by
  change
    MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom Polynomial.C
        (fun i : Fin n => Polynomial.X ^ (base ^ (i : ℕ)))
        (MvPolynomial.monomial e a) = _
  rw [MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_monomial, Finsupp.prod_pow]
  congr 1
  calc
    ∏ i : Fin n, (Polynomial.X ^ (base ^ (i : ℕ))) ^ e i =
        ∏ i : Fin n, Polynomial.X ^ (base ^ (i : ℕ) * e i) := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [← pow_mul]
    _ = Polynomial.X ^ weightedExponent base e := by
      simpa only [weightedExponent_apply] using
        (Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum Finset.univ
          (fun i : Fin n => base ^ (i : ℕ) * e i)
          (Polynomial.X : R[X]))

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.Kronecker.kroneckerSubstitution_eq_sum
statement:
theorem kroneckerSubstitution_eq_sum (base : ℕ)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) :
    kroneckerSubstitution (R := R) base p =
      ∑ e ∈ p.support,
        Polynomial.monomial (weightedExponent base e) (p.coeff e)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [p.as_sum]
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro e _
  rw [kroneckerSubstitution_monomial,
    Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.Kronecker.coeff_kroneckerSubstitution_of_mem_support
statement:
theorem coeff_kroneckerSubstitution_of_mem_support
    (base : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (weightedExponent base)
      (↑p.support : Set (Fin n →₀ ℕ)))
    {e : Fin n →₀ ℕ} (he : e ∈ p.support) :
    (kroneckerSubstitution (R := R) base p).coeff
        (weightedExponent base e) = p.coeff e
proof:
:= by
  rw [kroneckerSubstitution_eq_sum, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff,
    Finset.sum_eq_single e]
  · simp
  · intro f hf hfe
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_monomial, if_neg]
    intro hcode
    exact hfe (hinj hf he hcode)
  · intro hnot
    exact (hnot he).elim

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.Kronecker.coeff_kroneckerSubstitution_eq_zero_of_notMem_image
statement:
theorem coeff_kroneckerSubstitution_eq_zero_of_notMem_image
    (base : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ∉ p.support.image (weightedExponent base)) :
    (kroneckerSubstitution (R := R) base p).coeff k = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [kroneckerSubstitution_eq_sum, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro e he
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_monomial, if_neg]
  intro hcode
  apply hk
  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨e, he, hcode⟩

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.Kronecker.support_kroneckerSubstitution_eq_image
statement:
theorem support_kroneckerSubstitution_eq_image
    (base : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (weightedExponent base)
      (↑p.support : Set (Fin n →₀ ℕ))) :
    (kroneckerSubstitution (R := R) base p).support =
      p.support.image (weightedExponent base)
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  constructor
  · intro hk
    have hkne : (kroneckerSubstitution (R := R) base p).coeff k ≠ 0 :=
      Polynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hk
    by_contra hnot
    exact hkne
      (coeff_kroneckerSubstitution_eq_zero_of_notMem_image base p hnot)
  · intro hk
    obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hk
    apply Polynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr
    rw [coeff_kroneckerSubstitution_of_mem_support base p hinj he]
    exact MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp he

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.Kronecker.coeffs_kroneckerSubstitution_eq
statement:
theorem coeffs_kroneckerSubstitution_eq
    (base : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (weightedExponent base)
      (↑p.support : Set (Fin n →₀ ℕ))) :
    (kroneckerSubstitution (R := R) base p).coeffs = p.coeffs
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext a
  rw [Polynomial.mem_coeffs_iff, MvPolynomial.mem_coeffs_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
    rw [support_kroneckerSubstitution_eq_image base p hinj] at hk
    obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hk
    exact ⟨e, he, coeff_kroneckerSubstitution_of_mem_support base p hinj he⟩
  · rintro ⟨e, he, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨weightedExponent base e, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [support_kroneckerSubstitution_eq_image base p hinj]
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨e, he, rfl⟩
    · exact
        (coeff_kroneckerSubstitution_of_mem_support base p hinj he).symm

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.Kronecker.coeffs_kroneckerSubstitution_eq_of_totalDegree_le
statement:
theorem coeffs_kroneckerSubstitution_eq_of_totalDegree_le
    (base d : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
    (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ d) (hbase : d < base) :
    (kroneckerSubstitution (R := R) base p).coeffs = p.coeffs
proof:
:= by
  apply coeffs_kroneckerSubstitution_eq
  exact weightedExponent_injOn_support_of_totalDegree_le
    (p := p) (base := base) hdegree hbase

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.exists_dedekindMertens_mvCoefficientModule
statement:
theorem exists_dedekindMertens_mvCoefficientModule
    {n : ℕ} (f g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) :
    ∃ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q ∧
      mvCoefficientModule (A := A) f ^ q *
          mvCoefficientModule (A := A) g =
        mvCoefficientModule (A := A) f ^ (q - 1) *
          mvCoefficientModule (A := A) (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  let base := f.totalDegree + g.totalDegree + 2
  let K := Kronecker.kroneckerSubstitution (R := R) (n := n) base
  let F : R[X] := K f
  let G : R[X] := K g
  have hsum_lt : f.totalDegree + g.totalDegree < base := by
    dsimp [base]
    omega
  have hf_lt : f.totalDegree < base :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_right _ _) hsum_lt
  have hg_lt : g.totalDegree < base :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_left _ _) hsum_lt
  have hcoeff_f : F.coeffs = f.coeffs := by
    simpa [F, K] using
      (Kronecker.coeffs_kroneckerSubstitution_eq_of_totalDegree_le
        (R := R) base f.totalDegree f le_rfl hf_lt)
  have hcoeff_g : G.coeffs = g.coeffs := by
    simpa [G, K] using
      (Kronecker.coeffs_kroneckerSubstitution_eq_of_totalDegree_le
        (R := R) base g.totalDegree g le_rfl hg_lt)
  have hdegree_mul : (f * g).totalDegree ≤
      f.totalDegree + g.totalDegree :=
    MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul f g
  have hcoeff_mul : (K (f * g)).coeffs = (f * g).coeffs := by
    simpa [K] using
      (Kronecker.coeffs_kroneckerSubstitution_eq_of_totalDegree_le
        (R := R) base (f.totalDegree + g.totalDegree) (f * g)
          hdegree_mul hsum_lt)
  have hmap_mul : F * G = K (f * g) := by
    simp [F, G]
  have hcoeff_product : (F * G).coeffs = (f * g).coeffs := by
    rw [hmap_mul]
    exact hcoeff_mul
  have hmodule_f : coefficientModule (A := A) F =
      mvCoefficientModule (A := A) f := by
    rw [coefficientModule, mvCoefficientModule, hcoeff_f]
  have hmodule_g : coefficientModule (A := A) G =
      mvCoefficientModule (A := A) g := by
    rw [coefficientModule, mvCoefficientModule, hcoeff_g]
  have hmodule_product : coefficientModule (A := A) (F * G) =
      mvCoefficientModule (A := A) (f * g) := by
    rw [coefficientModule, mvCoefficientModule, hcoeff_product]
  have hdm := dedekindMertens_coefficientModule (A := A) F G
  rw [hmodule_f, hmodule_g, hmodule_product] at hdm
  refine ⟨G.natDegree + 1, Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le _), ?_⟩
  simpa using hdm

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.contentIdeal_mul_C_eq
statement:
theorem contentIdeal_mul_C_eq (f : R[X]) (b : R) :
    (f * C b).contentIdeal = f.contentIdeal * Ideal.span {b}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · simpa using Polynomial.contentIdeal_mul_le_mul_contentIdeal f (C b)
  · change
      Ideal.span (f.coeffs : Set R) * Ideal.span ({b} : Set R) ≤
        (f * C b).contentIdeal
    rw [Ideal.span_mul_span, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro x ⟨a, ha, c, hc, rfl⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hc
    subst c
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Polynomial.mem_coeffs_iff] at ha
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := ha
    simpa [Polynomial.coeff_mul_C] using
      (f * C b).coeff_mem_contentIdeal i

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.contentIdeal_le_erase_sup_span
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.contentIdeal_def, Ideal.span_le]
  intro x hx
  simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Polynomial.mem_coeffs_iff] at hx
  obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := hx
  by_cases hi : i = m
  · subst i
    exact (show Ideal.span {g.coeff m} ≤
      (g.erase m).contentIdeal ⊔ Ideal.span {g.coeff m} from
        le_sup_right) (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
  · apply (show (g.erase m).contentIdeal ≤
      (g.erase m).contentIdeal ⊔ Ideal.span {g.coeff m} from
        le_sup_left)
    have hmem := (g.erase m).coeff_mem_contentIdeal i
    simpa [Polynomial.coeff_erase, hi] using hmem

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.contentIdeal_mul_erase_le
statement:
theorem contentIdeal_mul_erase_le (f g : R[X]) (m : ℕ) :
    (f * g.erase m).contentIdeal ≤
      (f * g).contentIdeal ⊔
        f.contentIdeal * Ideal.span {g.coeff m}
proof:
:= by
  let t : R[X] := monomial m (g.coeff m)
  have hpoly : f * g.erase m + f * t = f * g := by
    rw [← mul_add]
    congr 1
    simpa [t, add_comm] using g.monomial_add_erase m
  rw [Polynomial.contentIdeal_def, Ideal.span_le]
  intro x hx
  simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Polynomial.mem_coeffs_iff] at hx
  obtain ⟨k, -, rfl⟩ := hx
  have hcoeff := congrArg (fun p : R[X] => p.coeff k) hpoly
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_add] at hcoeff
  have hleft : (f * g).coeff k ∈
      (f * g).contentIdeal ⊔
        f.contentIdeal * Ideal.span {g.coeff m} :=
    (show (f * g).contentIdeal ≤
      (f * g).contentIdeal ⊔
        f.contentIdeal * Ideal.span {g.coeff m} from le_sup_left)
      ((f * g).coeff_mem_contentIdeal k)
  have hterm0 :=
    Polynomial.contentIdeal_mul_le_mul_contentIdeal f t
      ((f * t).coeff_mem_contentIdeal k)
  have hterm : (f * t).coeff k ∈
      (f * g).contentIdeal ⊔
        f.contentIdeal * Ideal.span {g.coeff m} := by
    apply (show f.contentIdeal * Ideal.span {g.coeff m} ≤
      (f * g).contentIdeal ⊔
        f.contentIdeal * Ideal.span {g.coeff m} from le_sup_right)
    simpa [t] using hterm0
  rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq hcoeff]
  exact ((f * g).contentIdeal ⊔
    f.contentIdeal * Ideal.span {g.coeff m}).sub_mem hleft hterm

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.dedekindMertens_hard_bound
statement:
theorem dedekindMertens_hard_bound (f g : R[X]) (m : ℕ)
    (hg : g.natDegree ≤ m) :
    f.contentIdeal ^ (m + 1) * g.contentIdeal ≤
      f.contentIdeal ^ m * (f * g).contentIdeal
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing g with
  | zero =>
      have hg0 : g.natDegree = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hg
      rw [Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hg0]
      simp [contentIdeal_mul_C_eq]
  | succ n ih =>
      let m := n + 1
      let F : Ideal R := f.contentIdeal
      let Q : Ideal R := (g.erase m).contentIdeal
      let b : R := g.coeff m
      let H : Ideal R := (f * g).contentIdeal
      let K : Ideal R := F ^ m * H
      have hm : m = n + 1 := rfl
      have hqdeg : (g.erase m).natDegree ≤ n := by
        rw [Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero]
        intro j hj
        rw [Polynomial.coeff_erase]
        split_ifs with heq
        · rfl
        · apply g.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt
          have hmj : m < j := by
            have hmle : m ≤ j := by
              simpa [m] using (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hj)
            exact lt_of_le_of_ne hmle (fun h => heq h.symm)
          exact hg.trans_lt (by simpa [m] using hmj)
      have hrec : F ^ m * Q ≤
          F ^ n * (f * g.erase m).contentIdeal := by
        simpa [F, Q, m] using ih (g.erase m) hqdeg
      have herase : (f * g.erase m).contentIdeal ≤
          H ⊔ F * Ideal.span {b} := by
        simpa [F, H, b] using contentIdeal_mul_erase_le f g m

      let A : ℕ → Prop := fun i =>
        Ideal.span {f.coeff i} * (F ^ m * Q) ≤ K
      let B : ℕ → Prop := fun i =>
        Ideal.span {f.coeff i * b} * F ^ m ≤ K
      let Tail : ℕ → Prop := fun i =>
        ∀ j, i ≤ j → A j ∧ B j

      have htail_top : Tail (f.natDegree + 1) := by
        intro j hj
        have hzero : f.coeff j = 0 :=
          f.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt
            ((Nat.lt_succ_self f.natDegree).trans_le hj)
        simp [A, B, hzero]

      have htail_step : ∀ i < f.natDegree + 1,
          Tail (i + 1) → Tail i := by
        intro i hi htail j hij
        by_cases hji : j = i
        · subst j
          have hB : B i := by
            change Ideal.span {f.coeff i * b} * F ^ m ≤ K
            rw [Ideal.span_singleton_mul_le_iff]
            intro u hu
            let S := (Finset.antidiagonal (i + m)).erase (i, m)
            have himem : (i, m) ∈ Finset.antidiagonal (i + m) := by
              simp
            have hconv : (f * g).coeff (i + m) =
                f.coeff i * b +
                  ∑ p ∈ S, f.coeff p.1 * g.coeff p.2 := by
              rw [Polynomial.coeff_mul,
                ← Finset.insert_erase himem,
                Finset.sum_insert (Finset.notMem_erase _ _)]
            have hmain : (f * g).coeff (i + m) * u ∈ K := by
              simpa [mul_comm] using Ideal.mul_mem_mul hu
                ((f * g).coeff_mem_contentIdeal (i + m))
            have hsum :
                (∑ p ∈ S, f.coeff p.1 * g.coeff p.2) * u ∈ K := by
              rw [Finset.sum_mul]
              apply K.sum_mem
              intro p hp
              rw [Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
              rcases p with ⟨x, y⟩
              by_cases hym : m < y
              · have hgy : g.coeff y = 0 :=
                  g.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt
                    (hg.trans_lt (by simpa [m] using hym))
                simp [hgy]
              · have hymle : y ≤ m := Nat.le_of_not_gt hym
                have hyne : y ≠ m := by
                  intro hy
                  apply hp.1
                  have hx : x = i := by
                    simpa [hy] using hp.2
                  simp [hx, hy]
                have hylt : y < m := lt_of_le_of_ne hymle hyne
                have hix : i < x := by
                  by_contra hix
                  have hbad : x + y < i + m :=
                    Nat.add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_of_not_gt hix) hylt
                  rw [hp.2] at hbad
                  exact (Nat.lt_irrefl _ hbad)
                have hqcoeff : g.coeff y ∈ Q := by
                  have hmem := (g.erase m).coeff_mem_contentIdeal y
                  simpa [Q, Polynomial.coeff_erase, hyne] using hmem
                have hAx :=
                  (htail x (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hix)).1
                have hAx' := Ideal.span_singleton_mul_le_iff.mp hAx
                have huz : u * g.coeff y ∈ F ^ m * Q :=
                  Ideal.mul_mem_mul hu hqcoeff
                convert hAx' (u * g.coeff y) huz using 1; ring
            rw [hconv] at hmain
            convert K.sub_mem hmain hsum using 1; ring
          have hA : A i := by
            change Ideal.span {f.coeff i} * (F ^ m * Q) ≤ K
            rw [Ideal.span_singleton_mul_le_iff]
            intro z hz
            have hz' : z ∈ F ^ n * (f * g.erase m).contentIdeal := hrec hz
            have hmul : Ideal.span {f.coeff i} *
                (F ^ n * (f * g.erase m).contentIdeal) ≤ K := by
              calc
                Ideal.span {f.coeff i} *
                    (F ^ n * (f * g.erase m).contentIdeal)
                    ≤ Ideal.span {f.coeff i} *
                        (F ^ n * (H ⊔ F * Ideal.span {b})) :=
                  Ideal.mul_mono le_rfl
                    (Ideal.mul_mono le_rfl herase)
                _ = (Ideal.span {f.coeff i} * (F ^ n * H)) ⊔
                    (Ideal.span {f.coeff i} *
                      (F ^ n * (F * Ideal.span {b}))) := by
                  rw [Ideal.mul_sup, Ideal.mul_sup]
                _ ≤ K := by
                  apply sup_le
                  · calc
                      Ideal.span {f.coeff i} * (F ^ n * H)
                          = (Ideal.span {f.coeff i} * F ^ n) * H := by
                            rw [Ideal.mul_assoc]
                      _ ≤ (F * F ^ n) * H :=
                        Ideal.mul_mono
                          (Ideal.mul_mono
                            (Ideal.span_le.mpr
                              (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr
                                (f.coeff_mem_contentIdeal i))) le_rfl)
                          le_rfl
                      _ = K := by simp [K, hm, pow_succ']
                  · have hrew :
                        Ideal.span {f.coeff i} *
                            (F ^ n * (F * Ideal.span {b})) =
                          Ideal.span {f.coeff i * b} * F ^ m := by
                        rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton,
                          pow_succ']
                        ac_rfl
                    rw [hrew]
                    exact hB
            exact (Ideal.span_singleton_mul_le_iff.mp hmul) z hz'
          exact ⟨hA, hB⟩
        · have hijlt : i < j :=
            lt_of_le_of_ne hij (Ne.symm hji)
          exact htail j (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hijlt)

      have htail_zero : Tail 0 :=
        Nat.decreasingInduction
          (n := f.natDegree + 1)
          (fun i hi htail => htail_step i hi htail)
          htail_top (Nat.zero_le _)
      have hall (i : ℕ) : A i ∧ B i := htail_zero i (Nat.zero_le i)

      have hF_A : F ≤ K.colon (F ^ m * Q : Set R) := by
        change f.contentIdeal ≤ K.colon (F ^ m * Q : Set R)
        rw [Polynomial.contentIdeal_def, Ideal.span_le]
        intro x hx
        simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Polynomial.mem_coeffs_iff] at hx
        obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := hx
        apply Submodule.mem_colon.mpr
        intro z hz
        have hAi := Ideal.span_singleton_mul_le_iff.mp (hall i).1
        simpa [smul_eq_mul] using hAi z hz
      have hQ : F * (F ^ m * Q) ≤ K := by
        apply Ideal.mul_le.2
        intro a ha z hz
        have ha' := Submodule.mem_colon.mp (hF_A ha) z hz
        simpa [smul_eq_mul] using ha'

      let L : Ideal R := K.colon (↑(F ^ m) : Set R)
      have hF_B : F ≤ L.colon (Ideal.span {b} : Set R) := by
        change f.contentIdeal ≤ L.colon (Ideal.span {b} : Set R)
        rw [Polynomial.contentIdeal_def, Ideal.span_le]
        intro x hx
        simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Polynomial.mem_coeffs_iff] at hx
        obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := hx
        rw [Ideal.colon_span]
        apply Submodule.mem_colon.mpr
        intro y hy
        simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
        subst y
        change f.coeff i * b ∈ K.colon (↑(F ^ m) : Set R)
        apply Submodule.mem_colon.mpr
        intro u hu
        have hBi := Ideal.span_singleton_mul_le_iff.mp (hall i).2
        simpa [smul_eq_mul] using hBi u hu
      have hFb : F * Ideal.span {b} ≤ L := by
        apply Ideal.mul_le.2
        intro a ha y hy
        have ha' := Submodule.mem_colon.mp (hF_B ha) y hy
        simpa [smul_eq_mul] using ha'
      have hb : (F * Ideal.span {b}) * F ^ m ≤ K := by
        apply Ideal.mul_le.2
        intro x hx u hu
        have hx' := Submodule.mem_colon.mp (hFb hx) u hu
        simpa [L, smul_eq_mul] using hx'

      have hG : g.contentIdeal ≤ Q ⊔ Ideal.span {b} := by
        simpa [Q, b] using contentIdeal_le_erase_sup_span g m
      calc
        f.contentIdeal ^ (n + 1 + 1) * g.contentIdeal
            ≤ F ^ (m + 1) * (Q ⊔ Ideal.span {b}) := by
              simpa [F, m] using Ideal.mul_mono le_rfl hG
        _ = (F ^ (m + 1) * Q) ⊔
              (F ^ (m + 1) * Ideal.span {b}) := by
              rw [Ideal.mul_sup]
        _ ≤ K := by
          apply sup_le
          · simpa [pow_succ', Ideal.mul_assoc] using hQ
          · have hrew : F ^ (m + 1) * Ideal.span {b} =
                (F * Ideal.span {b}) * F ^ m := by
              rw [pow_succ']
              ac_rfl
            rw [hrew]
            exact hb
        _ = f.contentIdeal ^ (n + 1) * (f * g).contentIdeal := by
          simp [K, F, H, m]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.dedekindMertens
statement:
theorem dedekindMertens (f g : R[X]) :
    f.contentIdeal ^ (g.natDegree + 1) * g.contentIdeal =
      f.contentIdeal ^ g.natDegree * (f * g).contentIdeal
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact dedekindMertens_hard_bound f g g.natDegree le_rfl
  · calc
      f.contentIdeal ^ g.natDegree * (f * g).contentIdeal
          ≤ f.contentIdeal ^ g.natDegree *
              (f.contentIdeal * g.contentIdeal) :=
        Ideal.mul_mono le_rfl
          (Polynomial.contentIdeal_mul_le_mul_contentIdeal f g)
      _ = f.contentIdeal ^ (g.natDegree + 1) * g.contentIdeal := by
        rw [pow_succ]
        ac_rfl

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.contentIdeal_C_add_C_mul_X
statement:
theorem contentIdeal_C_add_C_mul_X (b₀ b₁ : R) :
    (C b₀ + C b₁ * X).contentIdeal = Ideal.span {b₀, b₁}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Polynomial.contentIdeal_def, Ideal.span_le]
    intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Polynomial.mem_coeffs_iff] at hx
    obtain ⟨n, -, rfl⟩ := hx
    have hb₀ : b₀ ∈ Ideal.span ({b₀, b₁} : Set R) :=
      Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
    have hb₁ : b₁ ∈ Ideal.span ({b₀, b₁} : Set R) :=
      Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
    rcases n with _ | n
    · simpa using hb₀
    · rcases n with _ | n
      · simpa using hb₁
      · simp
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    have hcoeff_zero : (C b₀ + C b₁ * X).coeff 0 = b₀ := by
      rw [coeff_add, coeff_mul_X_zero]
      simp
    have hcoeff_one : (C b₀ + C b₁ * X).coeff 1 = b₁ := by
      rw [coeff_add, coeff_mul_X]
      simp
    have hmem_zero := (C b₀ + C b₁ * X).coeff_mem_contentIdeal 0
    have hmem_one := (C b₀ + C b₁ * X).coeff_mem_contentIdeal 1
    rw [hcoeff_zero] at hmem_zero
    rw [hcoeff_one] at hmem_one
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · rw [hx]
      exact hmem_zero
    · rw [hx]
      exact hmem_one

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.contentIdeal_sq_mul_span_pair_le_mul_contentIdeal
statement:
theorem contentIdeal_sq_mul_span_pair_le_mul_contentIdeal
    (f : R[X]) (b₀ b₁ : R) :
    f.contentIdeal ^ 2 * Ideal.span {b₀, b₁} ≤
      f.contentIdeal * (f * (C b₀ + C b₁ * X)).contentIdeal
proof:
:= by
  let g : R[X] := C b₀ + C b₁ * X
  let K : Ideal R := f.contentIdeal * (f * g).contentIdeal
  have hcoeff_zero : (f * g).coeff 0 = f.coeff 0 * b₀ := by
    simp [g, mul_add]
  have hcoeff_succ (n : ℕ) :
      (f * g).coeff (n + 1) =
        f.coeff (n + 1) * b₀ + f.coeff n * b₁ := by
    change (f * (C b₀ + C b₁ * X)).coeff (n + 1) = _
    rw [mul_add, coeff_add, coeff_mul_C, ← mul_assoc, coeff_mul_X,
      coeff_mul_C]
  have hprod (i k : ℕ) : f.coeff i * (f * g).coeff k ∈ K := by
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (f.coeff_mem_contentIdeal i)
      ((f * g).coeff_mem_contentIdeal k)
  have hb₁ : ∀ i j : ℕ, f.coeff i * f.coeff j * b₁ ∈ K := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero =>
        intro j
        have hleft := hprod 0 (j + 1)
        have hright := hprod (j + 1) 0
        rw [hcoeff_succ j] at hleft
        rw [hcoeff_zero] at hright
        convert K.sub_mem hleft hright using 1
        all_goals ring
    | succ i ih =>
        intro j
        have hleft := hprod (i + 1) (j + 1)
        have hright := hprod (j + 1) (i + 1)
        rw [hcoeff_succ j] at hleft
        rw [hcoeff_succ i] at hright
        have h := K.add_mem (K.sub_mem hleft hright) (ih (j + 1))
        convert h using 1
        all_goals ring
  have hb₀ : ∀ i j : ℕ, f.coeff i * f.coeff j * b₀ ∈ K := by
    intro i j
    rcases j with _ | j
    · have h := hprod i 0
      rw [hcoeff_zero] at h
      convert h using 1
      all_goals ring
    · have hleft := hprod i (j + 1)
      rw [hcoeff_succ j] at hleft
      convert K.sub_mem hleft (hb₁ i j) using 1
      all_goals ring
  change
    (Ideal.span (f.coeffs : Set R)) ^ 2 * Ideal.span {b₀, b₁} ≤ _
  rw [pow_two, Ideal.span_mul_span, Ideal.span_mul_span, Ideal.span_le]
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨ab, hab, b, hb, rfl⟩
  rcases hab with ⟨a, ha, a', ha', rfl⟩
  simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Polynomial.mem_coeffs_iff] at ha ha'
  obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨j, -, rfl⟩ := ha'
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hb
  rcases hb with rfl | rfl
  · simpa [K, g, mul_assoc] using hb₀ i j
  · simpa [K, g, mul_assoc] using hb₁ i j

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.mul_le_sq_mul_of_le_mul
statement:
theorem mul_le_sq_mul_of_le_mul {I J K : Ideal R} (h : K ≤ I * J) :
    I * K ≤ I ^ 2 * J
proof:
:= by
  calc
    I * K ≤ I * (I * J) := mul_le_mul' le_rfl h
    _ = I ^ 2 * J := by rw [pow_two, Ideal.mul_assoc]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.dedekindMertens_linear
statement:
theorem dedekindMertens_linear (f : R[X]) (b₀ b₁ : R) :
    f.contentIdeal ^ 2 * (C b₀ + C b₁ * X).contentIdeal =
      f.contentIdeal * (f * (C b₀ + C b₁ * X)).contentIdeal
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [contentIdeal_C_add_C_mul_X]
    exact contentIdeal_sq_mul_span_pair_le_mul_contentIdeal f b₀ b₁
  · exact mul_le_sq_mul_of_le_mul
      (Polynomial.contentIdeal_mul_le_mul_contentIdeal _ _)

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.eq_C_add_C_mul_X_of_natDegree_le_one
statement:
theorem eq_C_add_C_mul_X_of_natDegree_le_one (g : R[X])
    (hg : g.natDegree ≤ 1) :
    g = C (g.coeff 0) + C (g.coeff 1) * X
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  cases n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n =>
      cases n with
      | zero => simp
      | succ n =>
          have hzero : g.coeff (n + 2) = 0 :=
            g.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt
              (hg.trans_lt (Nat.succ_lt_succ (Nat.zero_lt_succ n)))
          simpa [coeff_add, coeff_C_mul] using hzero

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.dedekindMertens_of_natDegree_le_one
statement:
theorem dedekindMertens_of_natDegree_le_one (f g : R[X])
    (hg : g.natDegree ≤ 1) :
    f.contentIdeal ^ 2 * g.contentIdeal =
      f.contentIdeal * (f * g).contentIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_C_add_C_mul_X_of_natDegree_le_one g hg]
  exact dedekindMertens_linear f (g.coeff 0) (g.coeff 1)

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.exists_dedekindMertens_exponent_linear
statement:
theorem exists_dedekindMertens_exponent_linear (f : R[X]) (b₀ b₁ : R) :
    ∃ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q ∧
      f.contentIdeal ^ q * (C b₀ + C b₁ * X).contentIdeal =
        f.contentIdeal ^ (q - 1) *
          (f * (C b₀ + C b₁ * X)).contentIdeal
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨2, by decide, ?_⟩
  simpa using dedekindMertens_linear f b₀ b₁

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.radical_span_eq_of_dvd_pow
statement:
theorem radical_span_eq_of_dvd_pow
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {e r : R}
    (he : e ∣ r) (n : ℕ) (hr : r ∣ e ^ n) :
    (Ideal.span {r}).radical = (Ideal.span {e}).radical
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact Ideal.radical_mono <|
      Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton.mpr he
  · have he_mem : e ∈ (Ideal.span {r}).radical :=
      ⟨n, Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr hr⟩
    have hspan : Ideal.span {e} ≤ (Ideal.span {r}).radical :=
      Ideal.span_le.mpr <| Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr he_mem
    simpa using Ideal.radical_mono hspan

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.map_eq_zero_iff_of_dvd_pow
statement:
theorem map_eq_zero_iff_of_dvd_pow
    {R K : Type*} [CommRing R] [Field K]
    (φ : R →+* K) {e r : R} (he : e ∣ r) (n : ℕ) (hr : r ∣ e ^ n) :
    φ r = 0 ↔ φ e = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hφr
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hr
    have hpow : φ e ^ n = 0 := by
      rw [← map_pow, hc, map_mul, hφr, zero_mul]
    by_contra hφe
    exact (pow_ne_zero n hφe) hpow
  · intro hφe
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := he
    rw [hc, map_mul, hφe, zero_mul]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.aeval_eq_zero_iff_of_dvd_pow
statement:
theorem aeval_eq_zero_iff_of_dvd_pow
    {P K σ : Type*} [Field P] [Field K] [Algebra P K]
    (x : σ → K) {e r : MvPolynomial σ P}
    (he : e ∣ r) (n : ℕ) (hr : r ∣ e ^ n) :
    MvPolynomial.aeval x r = 0 ↔ MvPolynomial.aeval x e = 0
proof:
:=
  map_eq_zero_iff_of_dvd_pow (MvPolynomial.aeval x).toRingHom he n hr

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.vanishingSet_eq_of_dvd_pow
statement:
theorem vanishingSet_eq_of_dvd_pow
    {P K σ : Type*} [Field P] [Field K] [Algebra P K]
    {e r : MvPolynomial σ P} (he : e ∣ r) (n : ℕ) (hr : r ∣ e ^ n) :
    {x : σ → K | MvPolynomial.aeval x r = 0} =
      {x : σ → K | MvPolynomial.aeval x e = 0}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact aeval_eq_zero_iff_of_dvd_pow x he n hr

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.Idealtheorie1921.finiteBasis_iff_noetherian
statement:
theorem finiteBasis_iff_noetherian (R : Type*) [Semiring R] :
    IsNoetherianRing R ↔ ∀ I : Ideal R, I.FG
proof:
:=
  isNoetherianRing_iff_ideal_fg R

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.Idealtheorie1921.finiteIrreducibleDecomposition
statement:
theorem finiteIrreducibleDecomposition
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (I : Ideal R) :
    ∃ s : Finset (Ideal R), s.inf id = I ∧ ∀ ⦃J⦄, J ∈ s → InfIrred J
proof:
:=
  exists_infIrred_decomposition I

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.Idealtheorie1921.primary_iff_factor_or_power
statement:
theorem primary_iff_factor_or_power
    {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {Q : Ideal R} :
    Q.IsPrimary ↔ Q ≠ ⊤ ∧
      ∀ {a b : R}, a * b ∈ Q → a ∈ Q ∨ b ∈ Q.radical
proof:
:=
  Ideal.isPrimary_iff

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.Idealtheorie1921.primary_iff_ideal_product_or_power
statement:
theorem primary_iff_ideal_product_or_power
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] {Q : Ideal R} :
    Q.IsPrimary ↔ Q ≠ ⊤ ∧
      ∀ {A B : Ideal R}, A * B ≤ Q → A ≤ Q ∨
        ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ B ^ n ≤ Q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hQ
    refine ⟨hQ.ne_top, ?_⟩
    intro A B hAB
    by_cases hAQ : A ≤ Q
    · exact Or.inl hAQ
    · right
      have hB : B ≤ Q.radical := by
        obtain ⟨a, haA, haQ⟩ := SetLike.not_le_iff_exists.mp hAQ
        intro b hbB
        have habQ : a * b ∈ Q := hAB (Ideal.mul_mem_mul haA hbB)
        exact (Ideal.isPrimary_iff.mp hQ).2 habQ |>.resolve_left haQ
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Ideal.exists_pow_le_of_le_radical_of_fg hB B.fg_of_isNoetherianRing
      have hnpos : 0 < n := by
        apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
        intro hnzero
        have htop : (⊤ : Ideal R) ≤ Q := by simpa [hnzero] using hn
        exact hQ.ne_top (eq_top_iff.mpr htop)
      exact ⟨n, hnpos, hn⟩
  · rintro ⟨hQtop, hQ⟩
    rw [Ideal.isPrimary_iff]
    refine ⟨hQtop, ?_⟩
    intro x y hxy
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Q
    · exact Or.inl hx
    · right
      have hmul : Ideal.span {x} * Ideal.span {y} ≤ Q := by
        rw [Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton, Ideal.span_le]
        simpa using hxy
      have hxspan : ¬Ideal.span {x} ≤ Q := by
        simpa [Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem] using hx
      obtain ⟨n, -, hn⟩ := (hQ hmul).resolve_left hxspan
      refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
      apply hn
      rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
      exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _)

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.Idealtheorie1921.irreducible_isPrimary
proof:
:=
  hI.isPrimary

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.Idealtheorie1921.prime_isIrreducible
statement:
theorem prime_isIrreducible
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {P : Ideal R} (hP : P.IsPrime) : InfIrred P
proof:
:= by
  apply InfPrime.infIrred
  refine ⟨not_isMax_iff_ne_top.mpr hP.ne_top, ?_⟩
  intro I J hIJ
  exact hP.inf_le.mp hIJ

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.Idealtheorie1921.primaryDecomposition
statement:
theorem primaryDecomposition
    (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] : IsLasker R R
proof:
:=
  Submodule.isLasker R R

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.Idealtheorie1921.primaryFiniteInf_sameAssociatedPrime
statement:
theorem primaryFiniteInf_sameAssociatedPrime
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι : Type*} {s : Finset ι}
    {f : ι → Ideal R} {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ s)
    (hprimary : ∀ ⦃j⦄, j ∈ s → (f j).IsPrimary)
    (hradical : ∀ ⦃j⦄, j ∈ s → (f j).radical = (f i).radical) :
    (s.inf f).IsPrimary
proof:
:=
  Ideal.isPrimary_finsetInf hi hprimary hradical

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.Idealtheorie1921.existsUnique_associatedPrime
statement:
theorem existsUnique_associatedPrime
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (Q : Ideal R) (hQ : Q.IsPrimary) :
    ∃! P : Ideal R, P.IsPrime ∧ Q ≤ P ∧ ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ P ^ n ≤ Q
proof:
:= by
  have hPrime : Q.radical.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_radical hQ
  have hFG : Q.radical.FG :=
    (isNoetherianRing_iff_ideal_fg R).mp (by infer_instance) Q.radical
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Q.exists_radical_pow_le_of_fg hFG
  have hnpos : 0 < n := by
    apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    intro hnzero
    have htop : (⊤ : Ideal R) ≤ Q := by simpa [hnzero] using hn
    exact (Ideal.isPrimary_iff.mp hQ).1 (eq_top_iff.mpr htop)
  refine ⟨Q.radical, ⟨hPrime, Ideal.le_radical, ⟨n, hnpos, hn⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  intro P hP
  rcases hP with ⟨hPPrime, hQP, n, -, hPow⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · letI : Q.radical.IsPrime := hPrime
    exact Ideal.IsPrime.le_of_pow_le (hPow.trans Ideal.le_radical)
  · exact hPPrime.radical_le_iff.mpr hQP

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.Idealtheorie1921.associatedPrime_isGreatest_powerContained
statement:
theorem associatedPrime_isGreatest_powerContained
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (Q : Ideal R) (hQ : Q.IsPrimary) :
    Q.radical.IsPrime ∧ Q ≤ Q.radical ∧
      (∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ Q.radical ^ n ≤ Q) ∧
      ∀ B : Ideal R, (∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ B ^ n ≤ Q) → B ≤ Q.radical
proof:
:= by
  have hPrime : Q.radical.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_radical hQ
  have hFG : Q.radical.FG := Q.radical.fg_of_isNoetherianRing
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Q.exists_radical_pow_le_of_fg hFG
  have hnpos : 0 < n := by
    apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    intro hnzero
    have htop : (⊤ : Ideal R) ≤ Q := by simpa [hnzero] using hn
    exact hQ.ne_top (eq_top_iff.mpr htop)
  refine ⟨hPrime, Ideal.le_radical, ⟨n, hnpos, hn⟩, ?_⟩
  intro B hB
  rcases hB with ⟨m, -, hm⟩
  letI : Q.radical.IsPrime := hPrime
  exact Ideal.IsPrime.le_of_pow_le (hm.trans Ideal.le_radical)

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.Idealtheorie1921.exists_least_associatedPrimeExponent
statement:
theorem exists_least_associatedPrimeExponent
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (Q : Ideal R) (hQ : Q.IsPrimary) :
    ∃ ρ : ℕ, 0 < ρ ∧ Q.radical ^ ρ ≤ Q ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → Q.radical ^ n ≤ Q → ρ ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, hnpos, hn⟩ :=
    associatedPrime_isGreatest_powerContained Q hQ |>.2.2.1
  let hExists : ∃ k : ℕ, 0 < k ∧ Q.radical ^ k ≤ Q := ⟨n, hnpos, hn⟩
  let ρ := Nat.find hExists
  refine ⟨ρ, (Nat.find_spec hExists).1, (Nat.find_spec hExists).2, ?_⟩
  intro k hkpos hk
  exact Nat.find_min' hExists ⟨hkpos, hk⟩

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.AbsoluteIrreducibility1922.finite_prime_divisors
statement:
theorem finite_prime_divisors
    {M : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero M] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid M] [Fintype Mˣ]
    (a : M) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    {p : M | Prime p ∧ p ∣ a}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hdiv : {x : M | x ∣ a}.Finite :=
    Set.finite_def.mpr ⟨UniqueFactorizationMonoid.fintypeSubtypeDvd a ha⟩
  exact hdiv.subset fun _ hp ↦ hp.2

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.AbsoluteIrreducibility1922.finite_primeIdeal_divisors
statement:
theorem finite_primeIdeal_divisors
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDedekindDomain A]
    (I : Ideal A) (hI : I ≠ ⊥) :
    {P : Ideal A | P.IsPrime ∧ P ∣ I}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hdiv : {J : Ideal A | J ∣ I}.Finite :=
    Set.finite_def.mpr
      ⟨UniqueFactorizationMonoid.fintypeSubtypeDvd I
        (by simpa only [Ideal.zero_eq_bot] using hI)⟩
  exact hdiv.subset fun _ hP ↦ hP.2

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.DiscriminantTheorem1927.discr_basisQuotient
statement:
theorem discr_basisQuotient [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (b : Basis ι R S) :
    Algebra.discr (R ⧸ p) (basisQuotient b) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk p (Algebra.discr R b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Algebra.discr_def, Algebra.discr_def, RingHom.map_det]
  congr 1
  ext i j
  simp only [Algebra.traceMatrix_apply, Algebra.traceForm_apply,
    basisQuotient_apply, ← map_mul, Algebra.trace_quotient_mk,
    RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.map_apply]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.NoncommutativeAlgebras1933.matrixAlgEquiv_inner
statement:
theorem matrixAlgEquiv_inner
    {K n : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (f : Matrix n n K ≃ₐ[K] Matrix n n K) :
    ∃ X : GL n K, ∀ M : Matrix n n K,
      f M = (X : Matrix n n K) * M * ((X⁻¹ : GL n K) : Matrix n n K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : Matrix n n K ≃ₐ[K] Module.End K (n → K) := Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv'
  let fEnd : Module.End K (n → K) ≃ₐ[K] Module.End K (n → K) :=
    e.symm.trans (f.trans e)
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := AlgEquiv.eq_linearEquivConjAlgEquiv (f := fEnd)
  let X : GL n K :=
    (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin (n := n) (R := K)).symm
      (LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup.ofLinearEquiv T)
  refine ⟨X, fun M => ?_⟩
  apply e.injective
  have hX_toLin : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin X =
      LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup.ofLinearEquiv T := by
    simp [X]
  have hX_lin : e (X : Matrix n n K) = (T : (n → K) →ₗ[K] n → K) := by
    change ((Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin X :
      LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup K (n → K)) :
        (n → K) →ₗ[K] n → K) = (T : (n → K) →ₗ[K] n → K)
    rw [hX_toLin]
    rfl
  have hX_lin_inv :
      e ((X⁻¹ : GL n K) : Matrix n n K) =
        (T.symm : (n → K) →ₗ[K] n → K) := by
    have hX_toLin_inv : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin (X⁻¹) =
        LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup.ofLinearEquiv T.symm := by
      simp only [MulEquiv.map_inv, hX_toLin]
      exact (LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup.ofLinearEquiv_inv (f := T)).symm
    change ((Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin (X⁻¹) :
      LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup K (n → K)) :
        (n → K) →ₗ[K] n → K) =
      (T.symm : (n → K) →ₗ[K] n → K)
    rw [hX_toLin_inv]
    rfl
  calc
    e (f M) = fEnd (e M) := by simp [fEnd]
    _ = (T : (n → K) →ₗ[K] n → K) ∘ₗ e M ∘ₗ
          (T.symm : (n → K) →ₗ[K] n → K) := by
        rw [congrArg (· (e M)) hT]
        simp [LinearEquiv.conjAlgEquiv_apply]
    _ = e (X : Matrix n n K) * e M *
          e ((X⁻¹ : GL n K) : Matrix n n K) := by
        rw [← hX_lin, ← hX_lin_inv]
        simp [Module.End.mul_eq_comp, LinearMap.comp_assoc]
    _ = e ((X : Matrix n n K) * M *
          ((X⁻¹ : GL n K) : Matrix n n K)) := by
        simp [mul_assoc]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.NoncommutativeAlgebras1933.Quaternion.coe_jUnit
statement: theorem coe_jUnit : (jUnit : ℍ[ℝ]) = ⟨0, 0, 1, 0⟩
proof: := (rfl)

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.NoncommutativeAlgebras1933.Quaternion.coe_inv_jUnit
statement: theorem coe_inv_jUnit : ((jUnit⁻¹ : ℍ[ℝ]ˣ) : ℍ[ℝ]) = ⟨0, 0, -1, 0⟩
proof: := (rfl)

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.NoncommutativeAlgebras1933.Quaternion.ofComplex_I
statement:
theorem ofComplex_I :
    ofComplex Complex.I = (⟨0, 1, 0, 0⟩ : ℍ[ℝ])
proof:
:= by
  ext <;> simp [ofComplex]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.NoncommutativeAlgebras1933.Quaternion.conj_jUnit_ofComplex_I
statement:
theorem conj_jUnit_ofComplex_I :
    (jUnit : ℍ[ℝ]) * ofComplex Complex.I *
        ((jUnit⁻¹ : ℍ[ℝ]ˣ) : ℍ[ℝ]) =
      -ofComplex Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  have h :
      (⟨0, 0, 1, 0⟩ : ℍ[ℝ]) * (⟨0, 1, 0, 0⟩ : ℍ[ℝ]) *
          (⟨0, 0, -1, 0⟩ : ℍ[ℝ]) =
        -(⟨0, 1, 0, 0⟩ : ℍ[ℝ]) := by
    ext <;> simp
  rw [ofComplex_I, coe_jUnit, coe_inv_jUnit]
  exact h

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.NoncommutativeAlgebras1933.Quaternion.exists_unit_conj_of_mul_ne_one
statement:
private theorem exists_unit_conj_of_mul_ne_one
    {x u : ℍ[ℝ]} (hx : x * x = -1) (hu : u * u = -1)
    (h : u * x ≠ 1) :
    ∃ w : ℍ[ℝ]ˣ, u = (w : ℍ[ℝ]) * x * ((w⁻¹ : ℍ[ℝ]ˣ) : ℍ[ℝ])
proof:
:= by
  have hw : (1 : ℍ[ℝ]) - u * x ≠ 0 := fun hz =>
    h (by rw [sub_eq_zero] at hz; exact hz.symm)
  have h1 : u * x * x = -u := by
    rw [mul_assoc, hx]
    exact mul_neg_one u
  have h2 : u * (u * x) = -x := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, hu]
    exact neg_one_mul x
  have key : ((1 : ℍ[ℝ]) - u * x) * x = u * ((1 : ℍ[ℝ]) - u * x) := by
    rw [sub_mul, one_mul, mul_sub, mul_one, h1, h2, sub_neg_eq_add,
      sub_neg_eq_add]
    exact add_comm x u
  refine ⟨Units.mk0 _ hw, ?_⟩
  rw [Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, Units.val_mk0, key, mul_assoc,
    mul_inv_cancel₀ hw, mul_one]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.NoncommutativeAlgebras1933.Quaternion.exists_unit_conj_ofComplex_I
statement:
theorem exists_unit_conj_ofComplex_I {u : ℍ[ℝ]} (hu : u * u = -1) :
    ∃ w : ℍ[ℝ]ˣ,
      u = (w : ℍ[ℝ]) * ofComplex Complex.I *
        ((w⁻¹ : ℍ[ℝ]ˣ) : ℍ[ℝ])
proof:
:= by
  have hx :
      ofComplex Complex.I * ofComplex Complex.I = -1 :=
    (Complex.lift.symm ofComplex).prop
  by_cases h : u * ofComplex Complex.I = 1
  · have h2 : -u = ofComplex Complex.I := by
      have h3 :
          u * ofComplex Complex.I * ofComplex Complex.I =
            1 * ofComplex Complex.I := by
        rw [h]
      rw [mul_assoc, hx] at h3
      exact (mul_neg_one u).symm.trans (by simpa only [one_mul] using h3)
    exact ⟨jUnit, by rw [conj_jUnit_ofComplex_I, ← h2, neg_neg]⟩
  · exact exists_unit_conj_of_mul_ne_one hx hu h

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.NoncommutativeAlgebras1933.Quaternion.exists_unit_conj_of_mul_self_eq_neg_one
statement:
theorem exists_unit_conj_of_mul_self_eq_neg_one
    {u v : ℍ[ℝ]} (hu : u * u = -1) (hv : v * v = -1) :
    ∃ w : ℍ[ℝ]ˣ, v = (w : ℍ[ℝ]) * u * ((w⁻¹ : ℍ[ℝ]ˣ) : ℍ[ℝ])
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_unit_conj_ofComplex_I hu
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_unit_conj_ofComplex_I hv
  refine ⟨b * a⁻¹, ?_⟩
  rw [ha, hb]
  simp only [Units.val_mul, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, mul_assoc,
    Units.inv_mul_cancel_left]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.NoncommutativeAlgebras1933.Quaternion.conj_unit_complexAlgHom_apply
statement:
private theorem conj_unit_complexAlgHom_apply
    (w : ℍ[ℝ]ˣ) (f g : ℂ →ₐ[ℝ] ℍ[ℝ])
    (h : g Complex.I =
      (w : ℍ[ℝ]) * f Complex.I * ((w⁻¹ : ℍ[ℝ]ˣ) : ℍ[ℝ]))
    (z : ℂ) :
    g z = (w : ℍ[ℝ]) * f z * ((w⁻¹ : ℍ[ℝ]ˣ) : ℍ[ℝ])
proof:
:= by
  have hA :
      (w : ℍ[ℝ]) * algebraMap ℝ ℍ[ℝ] z.re *
          ((w⁻¹ : ℍ[ℝ]ˣ) : ℍ[ℝ]) =
        algebraMap ℝ ℍ[ℝ] z.re := by
    rw [← Algebra.commutes, mul_assoc, Units.mul_inv, mul_one]
  have hB :
      (w : ℍ[ℝ]) * (z.im • f Complex.I) *
          ((w⁻¹ : ℍ[ℝ]ˣ) : ℍ[ℝ]) =
        z.im • ((w : ℍ[ℝ]) * f Complex.I *
          ((w⁻¹ : ℍ[ℝ]ˣ) : ℍ[ℝ])) := by
