    rw [← _root_.Quaternion.coe_mul_eq_smul,
      ← _root_.Quaternion.coe_mul_eq_smul]
    rw [← mul_assoc (w : ℍ[ℝ]) (z.im : ℍ[ℝ]) (f Complex.I),
      ← _root_.Quaternion.coe_commutes]
    simp only [mul_assoc]
  conv_lhs => rw [← Complex.lift.apply_symm_apply g]
  conv_rhs => rw [← Complex.lift.apply_symm_apply f]
  simp only [Complex.lift_apply, Complex.liftAux_apply,
    Complex.lift_symm_apply_coe]
  rw [h, mul_add, add_mul, hA, hB]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.NoncommutativeAlgebras1933.Quaternion.exists_unit_conj_complexAlgHom
statement:
theorem exists_unit_conj_complexAlgHom (f g : ℂ →ₐ[ℝ] ℍ[ℝ]) :
    ∃ w : ℍ[ℝ]ˣ, ∀ z : ℂ,
      g z = (w : ℍ[ℝ]) * f z * ((w⁻¹ : ℍ[ℝ]ˣ) : ℍ[ℝ])
proof:
:= by
  have hf : f Complex.I * f Complex.I = -1 := (Complex.lift.symm f).prop
  have hg : g Complex.I * g Complex.I = -1 := (Complex.lift.symm g).prop
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_unit_conj_of_mul_self_eq_neg_one hf hg
  exact ⟨w, conj_unit_complexAlgHom_apply w f g hw⟩

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.NoncommutativeAlgebras1933.Quaternion.ofComplex_conjAe
statement:
theorem ofComplex_conjAe (z : ℂ) :
    ofComplex (Complex.conjAe z) =
      (jUnit : ℍ[ℝ]) * ofComplex z *
        ((jUnit⁻¹ : ℍ[ℝ]ˣ) : ℍ[ℝ])
proof:
:= by
  refine conj_unit_complexAlgHom_apply jUnit ofComplex
    (ofComplex.comp Complex.conjAe.toAlgHom) ?_ z
  change ofComplex (Complex.conjAe Complex.I) = _
  have hconj : Complex.conjAe Complex.I = -Complex.I := by
    exact Complex.conj_I
  rw [hconj, map_neg]
  exact conj_jUnit_ofComplex_I.symm

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.FiniteGroupInvariants1916.orbitPolynomial_eq
statement:
theorem orbitPolynomial_eq (x : R) :
    orbitPolynomial G R x = ∏ g : G, (X - C (g • x))
proof:
:=
  MulSemiringAction.charpoly_eq G x

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.FiniteGroupInvariants1916.orbitPolynomial_monic
statement:
theorem orbitPolynomial_monic (x : R) :
    (orbitPolynomial G R x).Monic
proof:
:=
  MulSemiringAction.monic_charpoly G x

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.FiniteGroupInvariants1916.orbitPolynomial_isRoot
statement:
theorem orbitPolynomial_isRoot (x : R) :
    (orbitPolynomial G R x).IsRoot x
proof:
:= by
  exact MulSemiringAction.eval_charpoly G x

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.FiniteGroupInvariants1916.orbitPolynomial_fixed
statement:
theorem orbitPolynomial_fixed (x : R) (g : G) :
    g • orbitPolynomial G R x = orbitPolynomial G R x
proof:
:=
  MulSemiringAction.smul_charpoly x g

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.FiniteGroupInvariants1916.orbitPolynomial_coeff_fixed
statement:
theorem orbitPolynomial_coeff_fixed (x : R) (n : ℕ) (g : G) :
    g • (orbitPolynomial G R x).coeff n =
      (orbitPolynomial G R x).coeff n
proof:
:=
  MulSemiringAction.smul_coeff_charpoly x n g

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.FiniteGroupInvariants1916.orbitPolynomial_audit_bundle
statement:
theorem orbitPolynomial_audit_bundle (x : R) :
    (orbitPolynomial G R x).Monic ∧
      (orbitPolynomial G R x).IsRoot x ∧
      (∀ g : G, g • orbitPolynomial G R x = orbitPolynomial G R x) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (g : G),
        g • (orbitPolynomial G R x).coeff n =
          (orbitPolynomial G R x).coeff n)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨orbitPolynomial_monic G R x,
    orbitPolynomial_isRoot G R x,
    orbitPolynomial_fixed G R x,
    orbitPolynomial_coeff_fixed G R x⟩

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.EquationsWithPrescribedGroup1918.elementarySymmetric_algebraicIndependent
statement:
theorem elementarySymmetric_algebraicIndependent
    (hn : n ≤ Fintype.card σ) :
    AlgebraicIndependent R (fun i : Fin n => esymm σ R (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [algebraicIndependent_iff_injective_aeval]
  intro p q hpq
  apply esymmAlgHom_injective R hn
  apply Subtype.ext
  simpa only [esymmAlgHom_apply] using hpq

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.CommonTailQuotient.inf_sup_eq_left_of_le_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem inf_sup_eq_left_of_le_of_disjoint
    (G M T : Submodule R E) (hMG : M ≤ G) (hGT : Disjoint G T) :
    G ⊓ (M ⊔ T) = M
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    rcases Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx.2 with ⟨m, hm, t, ht, rfl⟩
    have htG : t ∈ G := by
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using G.sub_mem hx.1 (hMG hm)
    have ht_zero : t = 0 := (Submodule.disjoint_def.mp hGT) t htG ht
    simpa [ht_zero] using hm
  · intro x hx
    exact ⟨hMG hx, (le_sup_left : M ≤ M ⊔ T) hx⟩

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.CommonTailQuotient.exists_commonTail_representative
statement:
theorem exists_commonTail_representative
    (G M T : Submodule R E) (hMG : M ≤ G) (hGT : Disjoint G T)
    (q : relativeQuotient (G ⊔ T) (M ⊔ T)) :
    ∃ g : G,
      q = (commonTailQuotientEquiv G M T hMG hGT).symm
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk g)
proof:
:= by
  let e := commonTailQuotientEquiv G M T hMG hGT
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ (e q)
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  change q = e.symm (Submodule.Quotient.mk g)
  apply e.injective
  simpa only [e.apply_symm_apply] using hg.symm

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.regularRemainder_mem_ideal
statement:
theorem regularRemainder_mem_ideal
    (I : Ideal (Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) P)))
    (C H : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) P) (k : ℕ)
    (hCI : MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P n C ∈ I)
    (hHI : MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P n H ∈ I) :
    regularRemainder C k H ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  have hmul : MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P n C * regularQuotient C k H ∈ I :=
    I.mul_mem_right _ hCI
  have hsub := I.sub_mem hHI hmul
  have hdecomp := regularRemainder_add_mul_regularQuotient C H k
  rw [← hdecomp] at hsub
  simpa using hsub

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.regularRemainder_mem_boundedPart
statement:
theorem regularRemainder_mem_boundedPart
    (I : Ideal (Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) P)))
    (C H : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) P)
    (hC : IsRegularInDegree (0 : Fin (n + 1)) k C)
    (hCI : MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P n C ∈ I)
    (hHI : MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P n H ∈ I) :
    regularRemainder C k H ∈ boundedPart I k
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨regularRemainder_mem_ideal I C H k hCI hHI, ?_⟩
  exact Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mpr (degree_regularRemainder_lt C H hC)

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.regularRemainder_eq_sum_monomial
statement:
theorem regularRemainder_eq_sum_monomial
    (C H : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) P)
    (hC : IsRegularInDegree (0 : Fin (n + 1)) k C) :
    regularRemainder C k H =
      ∑ i : Fin k, Polynomial.monomial (i : ℕ)
        (regularCoefficientVector C H hC i)
proof:
:= by
  let r : Polynomial.degreeLT (MvPolynomial (Fin n) P) k :=
    ⟨regularRemainder C k H,
      Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mpr (degree_regularRemainder_lt C H hC)⟩
  have h := (Polynomial.degreeLTEquiv (MvPolynomial (Fin n) P) k).symm_apply_apply r
  have hval := congrArg Subtype.val h
  simpa [Polynomial.degreeLTEquiv, regularCoefficientVector, r] using hval.symm

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.finSuccEquiv_eq_sum_monomial_add_mul_regularQuotient
statement:
theorem finSuccEquiv_eq_sum_monomial_add_mul_regularQuotient
    (C H : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) P)
    (hC : IsRegularInDegree (0 : Fin (n + 1)) k C) :
    MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P n H =
      (∑ i : Fin k, Polynomial.monomial (i : ℕ)
        (regularCoefficientVector C H hC i)) +
      MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P n C * regularQuotient C k H
proof:
:= by
  rw [← regularRemainder_eq_sum_monomial C H hC]
  exact (regularRemainder_add_mul_regularQuotient C H k).symm

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.regularIdeal_eq_boundedPart_sup_principalTail
statement:
theorem regularIdeal_eq_boundedPart_sup_principalTail
    (I : Ideal (Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) P)))
    (C : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) P)
    (hC : IsRegularInDegree (0 : Fin (n + 1)) k C)
    (hCI : MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P n C ∈ I) :
    I.restrictScalars (MvPolynomial (Fin n) P) =
      boundedPart I k ⊔ principalTail C
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro H hHI
    let Hmv : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) P :=
      (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P n).symm H
    have hHmv : MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P n Hmv ∈ I := by
      simpa [Hmv] using hHI
    have hrem : regularRemainder C k Hmv ∈ boundedPart I k :=
      regularRemainder_mem_boundedPart I C Hmv hC hCI hHmv
    have hgen : MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P n C ∈
        Ideal.span ({MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P n C} :
          Set (Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) P))) :=
      Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
    have htail : MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P n C *
        regularQuotient C k Hmv ∈ principalTail C := by
      change MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P n C * regularQuotient C k Hmv ∈
        Ideal.span ({MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P n C} :
          Set (Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) P)))
      exact (Ideal.span ({MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P n C} :
        Set (Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) P)))).mul_mem_right _ hgen
    have hsum : regularRemainder C k Hmv +
        MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P n C * regularQuotient C k Hmv ∈
        boundedPart I k ⊔ principalTail C :=
      (boundedPart I k ⊔ principalTail C).add_mem
        ((show boundedPart I k ≤ boundedPart I k ⊔ principalTail C from
          le_sup_left) hrem)
        ((show principalTail C ≤ boundedPart I k ⊔ principalTail C from
          le_sup_right) htail)
    rw [regularRemainder_add_mul_regularQuotient C Hmv k] at hsum
    simpa [Hmv] using hsum
  · apply sup_le
    · intro H hH
      exact hH.1
    · intro H hH
      have hspan : Ideal.span ({MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P n C} :
          Set (Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) P))) ≤ I :=
        Ideal.span_le.mpr (by simpa using hCI)
      exact hspan hH

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.DeterminantalIdealScaffold.kMinor_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kMinor_apply (A : Matrix m n R) (k : ℕ) (r : Fin k → m) (c : Fin k → n) :
    kMinor A k r c = (A.submatrix r c).det
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.DeterminantalIdealScaffold.kMinor_mem_determinantalIdeal
statement:
theorem kMinor_mem_determinantalIdeal
    (A : Matrix m n R) (k : ℕ) (r : Fin k → m) (c : Fin k → n) :
    kMinor A k r c ∈ determinantalIdeal A k
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [determinantalIdeal] using
    (Ideal.mem_span_range_self
      (f := fun rc : (Fin k → m) × (Fin k → n) => kMinor A k rc.1 rc.2)
      (x := (r, c)))

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.DeterminantalIdealScaffold.kMinor_eq_zero_of_row_eq
statement:
theorem kMinor_eq_zero_of_row_eq
    (A : Matrix m n R) (k : ℕ) (r : Fin k → m) (c : Fin k → n)
    {i j : Fin k} (hij : i ≠ j) (hrows : r i = r j) :
    kMinor A k r c = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold kMinor
  apply Matrix.det_zero_of_row_eq hij
  funext l
  simp [hrows]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.DeterminantalIdealScaffold.kMinor_eq_zero_of_column_eq
statement:
theorem kMinor_eq_zero_of_column_eq
    (A : Matrix m n R) (k : ℕ) (r : Fin k → m) (c : Fin k → n)
    {i j : Fin k} (hij : i ≠ j) (hcols : c i = c j) :
    kMinor A k r c = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold kMinor
  apply Matrix.det_zero_of_column_eq hij
  intro l
  simp [hcols]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.DeterminantalIdealScaffold.determinantalIdeal_eq_bot_of_forall_kMinor_eq_zero
statement:
theorem determinantalIdeal_eq_bot_of_forall_kMinor_eq_zero
    (A : Matrix m n R) (k : ℕ)
    (hzero : ∀ (r : Fin k → m) (c : Fin k → n), kMinor A k r c = 0) :
    determinantalIdeal A k = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [determinantalIdeal, Ideal.span_eq_bot]
  rintro x ⟨rc, rfl⟩
  exact hzero rc.1 rc.2

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.DeterminantalIdealScaffold.kMinor_zero_of_pos
statement:
theorem kMinor_zero_of_pos
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (r : Fin k → m) (c : Fin k → n) :
    kMinor (0 : Matrix m n R) k r c = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : Nonempty (Fin k) := ⟨⟨0, hk⟩⟩
  unfold kMinor
  change (0 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) R).det = 0
  exact Matrix.det_zero (inferInstance : Nonempty (Fin k))

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.DeterminantalIdealScaffold.determinantalIdeal_zero_of_pos
statement:
theorem determinantalIdeal_zero_of_pos
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    determinantalIdeal (0 : Matrix m n R) k = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply determinantalIdeal_eq_bot_of_forall_kMinor_eq_zero
  intro r c
  exact kMinor_zero_of_pos k hk r c

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.DeterminantalIdealScaffold.determinantalIdeal_zeroDegree
statement:
theorem determinantalIdeal_zeroDegree (A : Matrix m n R) :
    determinantalIdeal A 0 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply (Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).2
  let r : Fin 0 → m := fun i => Fin.elim0 i
  let c : Fin 0 → n := fun i => Fin.elim0 i
  have hminor : kMinor A 0 r c = 1 := by
    unfold kMinor
    exact Matrix.det_fin_zero
  rw [← hminor]
  exact kMinor_mem_determinantalIdeal A 0 r c

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SmithGroundReciprocity.mem_moduleQuotientByIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_moduleQuotientByIdeal
    (M : Submodule R E) (J : Ideal R) (x : E) :
    x ∈ moduleQuotientByIdeal M J ↔
      ∀ r : R, r ∈ J → r • x ∈ M
proof:
:= by
  simp [moduleQuotientByIdeal]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SmithGroundReciprocity.moduleQuotientByIdeal_span_singleton
statement:
theorem moduleQuotientByIdeal_span_singleton
    (M : Submodule R E) (e : R) :
    moduleQuotientByIdeal M (Ideal.span ({e} : Set R)) =
      M.comap (LinearMap.lsmul R E e)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_moduleQuotientByIdeal]
  change (∀ r : R, r ∈ Ideal.span ({e} : Set R) → r • x ∈ M) ↔
    e • x ∈ M
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact hx e (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
  · intro hx r hr
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hr
    rw [hc]
    simpa [smul_smul, mul_comm] using M.smul_mem c hx

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SmithGroundReciprocity.moduleQuotientByPrincipalIdeal_eq_of_saturation
statement:
theorem moduleQuotientByPrincipalIdeal_eq_of_saturation
    [NoZeroDivisors R] [Nontrivial R]
    (M G : Submodule R E) (e : R) (he : e ≠ 0)
    (hG : G = RegularIdealDecomposition.nonzeroScalarSaturation M)
    (hsmul : ∀ x ∈ G, e • x ∈ M) :
    moduleQuotientByIdeal M (Ideal.span ({e} : Set R)) = G
proof:
:= by
  rw [moduleQuotientByIdeal_span_singleton]
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    change e • x ∈ M at hx
    rw [hG]
    exact ⟨e, he, hx⟩
  · intro x hx
    change e • x ∈ M
    exact hsmul x hx

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SmithGroundReciprocity.moduleQuotientByIdeal_span_singleton_eq_top_of_isGreatest
statement:
theorem moduleQuotientByIdeal_span_singleton_eq_top_of_isGreatest
    (N : Submodule R E) (b : Basis ι R E) (e : ι → R)
    (hN : ∀ x, x ∈ N ↔ ∀ j, e j ∣ b.repr x j)
    (i : ι) (h : SmithScalarQuotients.IsGreatestRemainingDivisor e ∅ i) :
    moduleQuotientByIdeal N (Ideal.span ({e i} : Set R)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [moduleQuotientByIdeal_span_singleton]
  apply top_unique
  intro x _
  change e i • x ∈ N
  apply (hN (e i • x)).mpr
  intro j
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h.2 j (by simp)
  refine ⟨c * b.repr x j, ?_⟩
  rw [map_smul]
  simp only [Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hc]
  ac_rfl

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SmithGroundReciprocity.diagonalGroundReciprocity
statement:
theorem diagonalGroundReciprocity
    [Fintype ι]
    (N : Submodule R E) (b : Basis ι R E) (e : ι → R)
    (hN : ∀ x, x ∈ N ↔ ∀ j, e j ∣ b.repr x j)
    (i : ι) (h : SmithScalarQuotients.IsGreatestRemainingDivisor e ∅ i) :
    N.colon ((⊤ : Submodule R E) : Set E) =
        Ideal.span ({e i} : Set R) ∧
      moduleQuotientByIdeal N (Ideal.span ({e i} : Set R)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have hfirst := SmithScalarQuotients.filtration_colon_top_eq_span_of_isGreatest
      N b e hN ∅ i h
    rw [SmithScalarQuotients.filtration_empty] at hfirst
    exact hfirst
  · exact moduleQuotientByIdeal_span_singleton_eq_top_of_isGreatest
      N b e hN i h

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SmithGroundReciprocity.RegularIdealDecomposition.localizedSecondVariableGroundModule_eq_moduleQuotientBySmithCoefficient
statement:
theorem localizedSecondVariableGroundModule_eq_moduleQuotientBySmithCoefficient
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) P)) (k : ℕ)
    (i : localizedSecondVariableSmithIndex I k)
    (h : localizedSecondVariableIsGreatestRemainingDivisor I k ∅ i) :
    localizedSecondVariableGroundModule I k =
      SmithGroundReciprocity.moduleQuotientByIdeal
        (localizedSecondVariableOriginalModule I k)
        (Ideal.span
          ({localizedSecondVariableSmithCoefficients I k i} :
            Set (secondVariablePID P n)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [SmithGroundReciprocity.moduleQuotientByIdeal_span_singleton]
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    change localizedSecondVariableSmithCoefficients I k i • x ∈
      localizedSecondVariableOriginalModule I k
    let xG : localizedSecondVariableGroundCarrier I k := ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hxmul :
        localizedSecondVariableSmithCoefficients I k i • xG ∈
          localizedSecondVariableDenominatorCarrier I k := by
      apply (localizedSecondVariable_mem_denominatorCarrier_iff_dvd I k _).mpr
      intro j
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h.2 j (by simp)
      refine ⟨c * (localizedSecondVariableEtaBasis I k).repr xG j, ?_⟩
      rw [map_smul]
      simp only [Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hc]
      ac_rfl
    exact hxmul
  · intro x hx
    change localizedSecondVariableSmithCoefficients I k i • x ∈
      localizedSecondVariableOriginalModule I k at hx
    rw [localizedSecondVariableGroundModule_eq_saturation I k]
    exact ⟨localizedSecondVariableSmithCoefficients I k i,
      localizedSecondVariableSmithCoefficients_ne_zero I k i, hx⟩

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SmithGroundReciprocity.RegularIdealDecomposition.localizedSecondVariableSatzII_reciprocity
statement:
theorem localizedSecondVariableSatzII_reciprocity
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) P)) (k : ℕ)
    (i : localizedSecondVariableSmithIndex I k)
    (h : localizedSecondVariableIsGreatestRemainingDivisor I k ∅ i) :
    (localizedSecondVariableDenominatorCarrier I k).colon
        ((⊤ : Submodule (secondVariablePID P n)
          (localizedSecondVariableGroundCarrier I k)) :
          Set (localizedSecondVariableGroundCarrier I k)) =
        Ideal.span
          ({localizedSecondVariableSmithCoefficients I k i} :
            Set (secondVariablePID P n)) ∧
      localizedSecondVariableGroundModule I k =
        SmithGroundReciprocity.moduleQuotientByIdeal
          (localizedSecondVariableOriginalModule I k)
          (Ideal.span
            ({localizedSecondVariableSmithCoefficients I k i} :
              Set (secondVariablePID P n)))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have hfirst :=
      localizedSecondVariableSmithFiltration_colon_ground_eq_span_of_greatest
        I k ∅ i h
    rw [localizedSecondVariableSmithFiltration_empty] at hfirst
    exact hfirst
  · exact localizedSecondVariableGroundModule_eq_moduleQuotientBySmithCoefficient
      I k i h

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SatzVIIIOneStageDescent.hasEquation33Witness_iff_span_mul_le_succStageGroundIdeal
statement:
theorem hasEquation33Witness_iff_span_mul_le_succStageGroundIdeal
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) P)) (cutoff : ℕ)
    (e : MvPolynomial (Fin n) P) :
    HasEquation33Witness I cutoff e ↔
      Ideal.span ({e} : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin n) P)) *
          stageGroundIdeal (S := P) cutoff I ≤
        stageGroundIdeal (S := P) (cutoff + 1) I
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_mul_le_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h g hg
    exact equation33_mem_succStageGroundIdeal I cutoff e h hg
  · intro h g hg
    have heg := h g hg
    rw [mem_stageGroundIdeal_iff] at heg
    obtain ⟨b, hb0, hbfree, hbI⟩ := heg
    exact ⟨b, ⟨hb0, hbfree⟩, hbI⟩

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SatzVIIIOneStageDescent.stageGroundIdeal_card_eq
statement:
theorem stageGroundIdeal_card_eq
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) P)) :
    stageGroundIdeal (S := P) n I = I
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro g hg
    rw [mem_stageGroundIdeal_iff] at hg
    obtain ⟨b, hb0, hbfree, hbg⟩ := hg
    have hbvars : b.vars = ∅ :=
      Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr fun j ↦ hbfree j j.isLt
    have hbC : b = MvPolynomial.C (b.coeff 0) :=
      MvPolynomial.vars_eq_empty_iff_eq_C.mp hbvars
    have hcoeff : b.coeff 0 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      apply hb0
      rw [hbC, hzero]
      exact map_zero MvPolynomial.C
    have hbUnit : IsUnit b := by
      rw [hbC]
      exact (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hcoeff).map MvPolynomial.C
    exact (Ideal.unit_mul_mem_iff_mem I hbUnit).mp hbg
  · exact RegularIdealDecomposition.le_stageGroundIdeal n I

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SatzVIIIOneStageDescent.equation33_product_mul_mem_laterStageGroundIdeal
statement:
theorem equation33_product_mul_mem_laterStageGroundIdeal
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) P))
    (e : ℕ → MvPolynomial (Fin n) P) (start count : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ j < count, HasEquation33Witness I (start + j) (e j))
    {g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) P}
    (hg : g ∈ stageGroundIdeal (S := P) start I) :
    (∏ j ∈ Finset.range count, e j) * g ∈
      stageGroundIdeal (S := P) (start + count) I
proof:
:= by
  revert h
  induction count with
  | zero =>
      intro _h
      simpa
  | succ count ih =>
      intro h
      have hprev := ih
        (fun j hj ↦ h j (hj.trans (Nat.lt_succ_self count)))
      have hnext := equation33_mem_succStageGroundIdeal
        I (start + count) (e count)
        (h count (Nat.lt_succ_self count)) hprev
      simpa [Finset.prod_range_succ, Nat.add_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_comm,
        mul_left_comm] using hnext

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SatzVIIIOneStageDescent.equation33_partialProduct_mem_stageGroundIdeal
statement:
theorem equation33_partialProduct_mem_stageGroundIdeal
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) P)) (hI : I ≠ ⊥)
    (e : ℕ → MvPolynomial (Fin n) P) (count : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ j < count, HasEquation33Witness I j (e j)) :
    (∏ j ∈ Finset.range count, e j) ∈
      stageGroundIdeal (S := P) count I
proof:
:= by
  have hOne : (1 : MvPolynomial (Fin n) P) ∈
      stageGroundIdeal (S := P) 0 I := by
    rw [(RegularIdealDecomposition.stageGroundIdeal_zero_eq_top_iff I).2 hI]
    simp
  simpa using
    (equation33_product_mul_mem_laterStageGroundIdeal
      I e 0 count (by simpa using h) hOne)

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SatzVIIIOneStageDescent.equation33_fullProduct_mem
statement:
theorem equation33_fullProduct_mem
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) P)) (hI : I ≠ ⊥)
    (e : ℕ → MvPolynomial (Fin n) P)
    (h : ∀ j < n, HasEquation33Witness I j (e j)) :
    (∏ j ∈ Finset.range n, e j) ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [← stageGroundIdeal_card_eq I]
  exact equation33_partialProduct_mem_stageGroundIdeal I hI e n h

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SatzVIIIOneStageDescent.equation33_product_mul_mem_of_add_eq_card
statement:
theorem equation33_product_mul_mem_of_add_eq_card
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) P))
    (e : ℕ → MvPolynomial (Fin n) P) (start count : ℕ)
    (hend : start + count = n)
    (h : ∀ j < count, HasEquation33Witness I (start + j) (e j))
    {g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) P}
    (hg : g ∈ stageGroundIdeal (S := P) start I) :
    (∏ j ∈ Finset.range count, e j) * g ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  have hterminal := equation33_product_mul_mem_laterStageGroundIdeal
    I e start count h hg
  simpa [hend, stageGroundIdeal_card_eq I] using hterminal

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.localizedSecondVariableDenominatorBasis_eq_smul_eta
statement:
@[simp]
theorem localizedSecondVariableDenominatorBasis_eq_smul_eta
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) P)) (k : ℕ)
    (i : localizedSecondVariableSmithIndex I k) :
    ((localizedSecondVariableDenominatorBasis I k i :
        CommonTailQuotient.relativeDenominator
          (R := secondVariablePID P n)
          (E := localizedSecondVariableBoundedAmbient P n k)
          (localizedSecondVariableGroundModule I k)
          (localizedSecondVariableOriginalModule I k)) :
      localizedSecondVariableGroundModule I k) =
        localizedSecondVariableSmithCoefficients I k i •
          localizedSecondVariableEtaBasis I k i
proof:
:= by
  exact SmithPairedQuotient.relativeSmithBottomBasis_eq_smul
    (localizedSecondVariableGroundModule I k)
    (localizedSecondVariableOriginalModule I k)
    (localizedSecondVariableGroundBasis I k)
    (finrank_localizedSecondVariable_relativeDenominator_eq I k)
    i

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.localizedSecondVariable_smul_eta_mem_original
statement:
theorem localizedSecondVariable_smul_eta_mem_original
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) P)) (k : ℕ)
    (i : localizedSecondVariableSmithIndex I k) :
    ((localizedSecondVariableSmithCoefficients I k i •
        localizedSecondVariableEtaBasis I k i :
      localizedSecondVariableGroundModule I k) :
        localizedSecondVariableBoundedAmbient P n k) ∈
      localizedSecondVariableOriginalModule I k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← localizedSecondVariableDenominatorBasis_eq_smul_eta]
  exact SmithPairedQuotient.relativeSmithBottomBasis_mem
    (localizedSecondVariableGroundModule I k)
    (localizedSecondVariableOriginalModule I k)
    (localizedSecondVariableGroundBasis I k)
    (finrank_localizedSecondVariable_relativeDenominator_eq I k)
    i

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.localizedSecondVariableSmithCoefficients_ne_zero
statement:
theorem localizedSecondVariableSmithCoefficients_ne_zero
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) P)) (k : ℕ)
    (i : localizedSecondVariableSmithIndex I k) :
    localizedSecondVariableSmithCoefficients I k i ≠ 0
proof:

  exact SmithPairedQuotient.relativeSmithCoefficients_ne_zero
    (localizedSecondVariableGroundModule I k)
    (localizedSecondVariableOriginalModule I k)
    (localizedSecondVariableGroundBasis I k)
    (finrank_localizedSecondVariable_relativeDenominator_eq I k)

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SmithScalarQuotients.mem_basisFinsetSpan_iff
statement:
theorem mem_basisFinsetSpan_iff [Fintype ι]
    (b : Basis ι R E) (s : Finset ι) (x : E) :
    x ∈ basisFinsetSpan b s ↔
      ∀ i, i ∉ s → b.repr x i = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx i hi
    induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
        rcases hx with ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
        have hji : j ≠ i := fun hji => hi (hji ▸ hj)
        simp [Basis.repr_self, hji]
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
    | smul r x _ hx => simp [hx]
  · intro hx
    rw [← b.sum_repr x]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro i _
    by_cases hi : i ∈ s
    · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _
        (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)
    · rw [hx i hi, zero_smul]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SmithScalarQuotients.mem_iff_dvd_of_diagonal_bases
statement:
theorem mem_iff_dvd_of_diagonal_bases
    [Fintype ι]
    (N : Submodule R E) (b : Basis ι R E) (bN : Basis ι R N)
    (e : ι → R) (hdiag : ∀ i, (bN i : E) = e i • b i) (x : E) :
    x ∈ N ↔ ∀ i, e i ∣ b.repr x i
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [bN.mem_submodule_iff', hdiag]
  have hrepr : ∀ (c : ι → R) (i),
      b.repr (∑ j : ι, c j • e j • b j) i = e i * c i := by
    intro c i
    simp only [← mul_smul, b.repr_sum_self, mul_comm]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩ i
    exact ⟨c i, hrepr c i⟩
  · rintro h
    choose c hc using h
    exact ⟨c, b.ext_elem fun i => Eq.trans (hc i) (hrepr c i).symm⟩

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SmithScalarQuotients.mem_filtration_iff
statement:
theorem mem_filtration_iff
    [Fintype ι]
    (N : Submodule R E) (b : Basis ι R E) (e : ι → R)
    (hN : ∀ x, x ∈ N ↔ ∀ i, e i ∣ b.repr x i)
    (s : Finset ι) (x : E) :
    x ∈ filtration N b s ↔
      ∀ i, i ∉ s → e i ∣ b.repr x i
proof:
:= by
  have hrepr : ∀ (c : ι → R) (i),
      b.repr (∑ j : ι, c j • e j • b j) i = e i * c i := by
    intro c i
    simp only [← mul_smul, b.repr_sum_self, mul_comm]
  constructor
  · intro hx i hi
    obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx)
    have hz0 : b.repr z i = 0 :=
      (mem_basisFinsetSpan_iff b s z).mp hz i hi
    simpa [hz0] using (hN y).mp hy i
  · intro hx
    classical
    let c : ι → R := fun i =>
      if hi : i ∈ s then 0 else (hx i hi).choose
    have hc (i : ι) (hi : i ∉ s) :
        b.repr x i = e i * c i := by
      rw [show c i = (hx i hi).choose by simp [c, hi]]
      exact (hx i hi).choose_spec
    let y : E := ∑ i : ι, c i • e i • b i
    have hyrepr (i : ι) : b.repr y i = e i * c i := by
      simpa [y] using hrepr c i
    have hy : y ∈ N := by
      apply (hN y).mpr
      intro i
      exact ⟨c i, hyrepr i⟩
    let z : E := ∑ i ∈ s, b.repr x i • b i
    have hz : z ∈ basisFinsetSpan b s := by
      dsimp [z]
      apply Submodule.sum_mem
      intro i hi
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _
        (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)
    have hzrepr (i : ι) :
        b.repr z i = if i ∈ s then b.repr x i else 0 := by
      simp [z, Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply,
        Finset.sum_ite_eq']
    have hyz : y + z = x := by
      apply b.ext_elem
      intro i
      rw [map_add]
      change b.repr y i + b.repr z i = b.repr x i
      rw [hyrepr, hzrepr]
      by_cases hi : i ∈ s
      · simp [c, hi]
      · rw [hc i hi]
        simp [hi]
    apply Submodule.mem_sup.mpr
    exact ⟨y, hy, z, hz, hyz⟩

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SmithScalarQuotients.filtration_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filtration_empty (N : Submodule R E) (b : Basis ι R E) :
    filtration N b ∅ = N
proof:
:= by
  simp [filtration, basisFinsetSpan]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SmithScalarQuotients.basis_mem_filtration
statement:
theorem basis_mem_filtration (N : Submodule R E) (b : Basis ι R E)
    (s : Finset ι) {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ s) :
    b i ∈ filtration N b s
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.mem_sup_right
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SmithScalarQuotients.filtration_colon_insert_eq_span
statement:
theorem filtration_colon_insert_eq_span
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (N : Submodule R E) (b : Basis ι R E) (e : ι → R)
    (hN : ∀ x, x ∈ N ↔ ∀ i, e i ∣ b.repr x i)
    (s : Finset ι) (i : ι) (hi : i ∉ s) :
    (filtration N b s).colon
        ((filtration N b (insert i s) : Submodule R E) : Set E) =
      Ideal.span ({e i} : Set R)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext r
  constructor
  · intro hr
    have hrbi := (Submodule.mem_colon.mp hr) (b i)
      (basis_mem_filtration N b (insert i s) (Finset.mem_insert_self i s))
    have hdvd := (mem_filtration_iff N b e hN s (r • b i)).mp hrbi i hi
    apply Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr
    simpa using hdvd
  · intro hr
    apply Submodule.mem_colon.mpr
    intro x hx
    apply (mem_filtration_iff N b e hN s (r • x)).mpr
    intro j hj
    have hrepr : b.repr (r • x) j = r * b.repr x j := by simp
    rw [hrepr]
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hr
      refine ⟨c * b.repr x i, ?_⟩
      rw [hc]
      ac_rfl
    · have hjinsert : j ∉ insert i s := by simp [hji, hj]
      have hxj := (mem_filtration_iff N b e hN (insert i s) x).mp hx j hjinsert
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hxj
      refine ⟨r * c, ?_⟩
      rw [hc]
      ac_rfl

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SmithScalarQuotients.filtration_colon_top_eq_iInf
statement:
theorem filtration_colon_top_eq_iInf
    [Fintype ι]
    (N : Submodule R E) (b : Basis ι R E) (e : ι → R)
    (hN : ∀ x, x ∈ N ↔ ∀ i, e i ∣ b.repr x i)
    (s : Finset ι) :
    (filtration N b s).colon ((⊤ : Submodule R E) : Set E) =
      ⨅ j : {j : ι // j ∉ s}, Ideal.span ({e j.1} : Set R)
proof:
:= by
  ext r
  constructor
  · intro hr
    apply Ideal.mem_iInf.mpr
    intro j
    apply Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr
    have hrbj := (Submodule.mem_colon.mp hr) (b j.1) (Submodule.mem_top)
    have hdvd :=
      (mem_filtration_iff N b e hN s (r • b j.1)).mp hrbj j.1 j.2
    simpa using hdvd
  · intro hr
    apply Submodule.mem_colon.mpr
    intro x _
    apply (mem_filtration_iff N b e hN s (r • x)).mpr
    intro i hi
    have hri : e i ∣ r := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp
      (Ideal.mem_iInf.mp hr ⟨i, hi⟩)
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hri
    have hrepr : b.repr (r • x) i = r * b.repr x i := by simp
    rw [hrepr, hc]
    exact ⟨c * b.repr x i, by
      simp [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]⟩

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SmithScalarQuotients.iInf_remaining_eq_span_of_isGreatest
statement:
theorem iInf_remaining_eq_span_of_isGreatest
    (e : ι → R) (s : Finset ι) (i : ι)
    (h : IsGreatestRemainingDivisor e s i) :
    (⨅ j : {j : ι // j ∉ s}, Ideal.span ({e j.1} : Set R)) =
      Ideal.span ({e i} : Set R)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact iInf_le _ (⟨i, h.1⟩ : {j : ι // j ∉ s})
  · apply le_iInf
    intro j
    exact Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton.mpr (h.2 j.1 j.2)

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SmithScalarQuotients.filtration_colon_top_eq_span_of_isGreatest
statement:
theorem filtration_colon_top_eq_span_of_isGreatest
    [Fintype ι]
    (N : Submodule R E) (b : Basis ι R E) (e : ι → R)
    (hN : ∀ x, x ∈ N ↔ ∀ i, e i ∣ b.repr x i)
    (s : Finset ι) (i : ι)
    (h : IsGreatestRemainingDivisor e s i) :
    (filtration N b s).colon ((⊤ : Submodule R E) : Set E) =
      Ideal.span ({e i} : Set R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [filtration_colon_top_eq_iInf N b e hN s,
    iInf_remaining_eq_span_of_isGreatest e s i h]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SmithScalarQuotients.prod_top_sup_span_singleton_eq
statement:
theorem prod_top_sup_span_singleton_eq
    (A : Submodule R E) (x : E) :
    A.prod (⊤ : Submodule R F) ⊔
        Submodule.span R ({(x, 0)} : Set (E × F)) =
      (A ⊔ Submodule.span R ({x} : Set E)).prod
        (⊤ : Submodule R F)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply sup_le
    · exact Submodule.prod_mono le_sup_left le_rfl
    · rw [Submodule.span_le]
      intro y hy
      simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      subst y
      exact ⟨Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.subset_span (by simp)),
        Submodule.mem_top⟩
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨a, ha, z, hz, haz⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hy.1
    have hzpair : (z, 0) ∈ Submodule.span R ({(x, 0)} : Set (E × F)) := by
      have hzimage := Submodule.apply_mem_span_image_of_mem_span
        (LinearMap.inl R E F) hz
      simpa [LinearMap.inl_apply] using hzimage
    have hapair : (a, y.2) ∈ A.prod (⊤ : Submodule R F) :=
      ⟨ha, Submodule.mem_top⟩
    have hsum : (a, y.2) + (z, 0) ∈
        A.prod (⊤ : Submodule R F) ⊔
          Submodule.span R ({(x, 0)} : Set (E × F)) :=
      Submodule.add_mem_sup hapair hzpair
    change (y.1, y.2) ∈ _
    rw [← haz]
    simpa using hsum

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SmithScalarQuotients.prod_top_colon_prod_top
statement:
theorem prod_top_colon_prod_top (A B : Submodule R E) :
    (A.prod (⊤ : Submodule R F)).colon
        (((B.prod (⊤ : Submodule R F)) : Submodule R (E × F)) : Set (E × F)) =
      A.colon (B : Set E)
proof:
:= by
  ext r
  constructor
  · intro hr
    apply Submodule.mem_colon.mpr
    intro x hx
    have hpair := (Submodule.mem_colon.mp hr) (x, 0) ⟨hx, Submodule.mem_top⟩
    exact hpair.1
  · intro hr
    apply Submodule.mem_colon.mpr
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨(Submodule.mem_colon.mp hr) x.1 hx.1, Submodule.mem_top⟩

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.SmithScalarQuotients.prod_top_colon_top
statement:
theorem prod_top_colon_top (A : Submodule R E) :
    (A.prod (⊤ : Submodule R F)).colon
        ((⊤ : Submodule R (E × F)) : Set (E × F)) =
      A.colon ((⊤ : Submodule R E) : Set E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (⊤ : Submodule R (E × F)) =
      (⊤ : Submodule R E).prod (⊤ : Submodule R F) by
        ext y
        simp]
  exact prod_top_colon_prod_top (F := F) A ⊤

    localizedSecondVariableFullOriginalAdjoinEta_eq_filtration_singleton]

    ((localizedSecondVariableDenominatorCarrier I k).prod
      (⊤ : Submodule (secondVariablePID P n)

  rw [SmithScalarQuotients.prod_top_colon_prod_top
    (R := secondVariablePID P n)
    (E := localizedSecondVariableGroundCarrier I k)
    (F := tau →₀ secondVariablePID P n)
    (localizedSecondVariableDenominatorCarrier I k)
    (localizedSecondVariableSmithFiltration I k {i})]

statement:

    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) P)) (k : ℕ) (tau : Type*)
    (i : localizedSecondVariableSmithIndex I k)
    (h : ∀ j : localizedSecondVariableSmithIndex I k,
      localizedSecondVariableSmithCoefficients I k j ∣
        localizedSecondVariableSmithCoefficients I k i) :
    (localizedSecondVariableFullOriginalModule I k tau).colon
        ((localizedSecondVariableFullGroundModule I k tau :

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.mem_nonzeroScalarSaturation_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_nonzeroScalarSaturation_iff (M : Submodule R E) (x : E) :
    x ∈ nonzeroScalarSaturation M ↔
      ∃ b : R, b ≠ 0 ∧ b • x ∈ M
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.le_nonzeroScalarSaturation
statement:
theorem le_nonzeroScalarSaturation (M : Submodule R E) :
    M ≤ nonzeroScalarSaturation M
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact ⟨1, one_ne_zero, by simpa using hx⟩

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.nonzeroScalarSaturation_mono
statement:
theorem nonzeroScalarSaturation_mono {M N : Submodule R E} (hMN : M ≤ N) :
    nonzeroScalarSaturation M ≤ nonzeroScalarSaturation N
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨b, hb, hbx⟩
  exact ⟨b, hb, hMN hbx⟩

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.isGroundModule_iff_nonzeroScalarSaturation_eq
statement:
theorem isGroundModule_iff_nonzeroScalarSaturation_eq
    (G : Submodule R E) :
    IsGroundModule G ↔ nonzeroScalarSaturation G = G
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hG
    apply le_antisymm
    · rintro g ⟨b, hb, hbg⟩
      exact hG b g hb hbg
    · exact le_nonzeroScalarSaturation G
  · intro hG b g hb hbg
    have hg : g ∈ nonzeroScalarSaturation G := ⟨b, hb, hbg⟩
    rwa [hG] at hg

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.nonzeroScalarSaturation_idem
statement:
theorem nonzeroScalarSaturation_idem (M : Submodule R E) :
    nonzeroScalarSaturation (nonzeroScalarSaturation M) =
      nonzeroScalarSaturation M
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro x ⟨a, ha, hax⟩
    rcases hax with ⟨b, hb, hbax⟩
    refine ⟨b * a, mul_ne_zero hb ha, ?_⟩
    simpa [smul_smul] using hbax
  · exact le_nonzeroScalarSaturation (nonzeroScalarSaturation M)

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.nonzeroScalarSaturation_isGroundModule
statement:
theorem nonzeroScalarSaturation_isGroundModule (M : Submodule R E) :
    IsGroundModule (nonzeroScalarSaturation M)
proof:
:=
  (isGroundModule_iff_nonzeroScalarSaturation_eq _).2
    (nonzeroScalarSaturation_idem M)

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.nonzeroScalarSaturation_le_of_le_of_isGroundModule
statement:
theorem nonzeroScalarSaturation_le_of_le_of_isGroundModule
    {M G : Submodule R E} (hMG : M ≤ G) (hG : IsGroundModule G) :
    nonzeroScalarSaturation M ≤ G
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨b, hb, hbx⟩
  exact hG b x hb (hMG hbx)

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.nonzeroScalarSaturation_isLeast
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨le_nonzeroScalarSaturation M,
    nonzeroScalarSaturation_isGroundModule M⟩, ?_⟩
  intro G hG
  exact nonzeroScalarSaturation_le_of_le_of_isGroundModule hG.1 hG.2

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.finSuccEquiv_eq_C_coeff_zero_of_first_notMem_vars
statement:
theorem finSuccEquiv_eq_C_coeff_zero_of_first_notMem_vars
    (b : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) P)
    (hbfree : ∀ j : Fin (n + 2), j.1 < 1 → j ∉ b.vars) :
    MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P (n + 1) b =
      Polynomial.C ((MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P (n + 1) b).coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero
  rw [MvPolynomial.natDegree_finSuccEquiv]
  apply not_ne_iff.mp
  intro hdegree
  exact hbfree 0 (by simp)
    (MvPolynomial.mem_vars_iff_degreeOf_ne_zero.mpr hdegree)

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.finSuccEquiv_symm_C_first_notMem_vars
statement:
theorem finSuccEquiv_symm_C_first_notMem_vars
    (b : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) P) :
    ∀ j : Fin (n + 2), j.1 < 1 →
      j ∉ ((MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P (n + 1)).symm
        (Polynomial.C b)).vars
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj hmem
  have hj0 : j = 0 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hj)
  subst j
  rw [MvPolynomial.mem_vars_iff_degreeOf_ne_zero] at hmem
  apply hmem
  rw [← MvPolynomial.natDegree_finSuccEquiv]
  simp

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.mem_stageOneGroundIdeal_iff_exists_smul
statement:
theorem mem_stageOneGroundIdeal_iff_exists_smul
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) P))
    (F : Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) P)) :
    F ∈ stageOneGroundIdeal I ↔
      ∃ b : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) P,
        b ≠ 0 ∧ b • F ∈ finSuccIdeal (n := n + 1) I
proof:
:= by
  let e := MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv P (n + 1)
  change F ∈ (stageGroundIdeal (S := P) 1 I).map e.toRingEquiv ↔ _
  rw [← Ideal.symm_apply_mem_of_equiv_iff]
  rw [mem_stageGroundIdeal_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, hafree, haF⟩
    let b : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) P := (e a).coeff 0
    have hea : e a = Polynomial.C b :=
      finSuccEquiv_eq_C_coeff_zero_of_first_notMem_vars a hafree
    have hb : b ≠ 0 := by
      intro hb0
      apply ha
      apply e.injective
      simpa [hea, hb0]
    refine ⟨b, hb, ?_⟩
    have hmap : e (a * e.symm F) ∈ finSuccIdeal (n := n + 1) I :=
      finSuccEquiv_mem_finSuccIdeal I haF
    simpa [map_mul, e.apply_symm_apply, hea, Algebra.smul_def] using hmap
  · rintro ⟨b, hb, hbF⟩
    let a : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) P := e.symm (Polynomial.C b)
    have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
      intro ha0
      apply hb
      have := congrArg e ha0
      simpa [a] using this
    have hafree : ∀ j : Fin (n + 2), j.1 < 1 → j ∉ a.vars := by
      simpa [a, e] using
        (finSuccEquiv_symm_C_first_notMem_vars (P := P) (n := n) b)
    refine ⟨a, ha, hafree, ?_⟩
    have hback : e.symm (b • F) ∈ I :=
      Ideal.symm_apply_mem_of_equiv_iff.mpr hbF
    simpa [a, Algebra.smul_def, map_mul] using hback

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.boundedPartInDegreeLT_stageOneGroundIdeal_eq_saturation
statement:
theorem boundedPartInDegreeLT_stageOneGroundIdeal_eq_saturation
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) P)) (k : ℕ) :
    boundedPartInDegreeLT (stageOneGroundIdeal I) k =
      nonzeroScalarSaturation
        (boundedPartInDegreeLT (finSuccIdeal (n := n + 1) I) k)
proof:
:= by
  ext r
  rw [mem_boundedPartInDegreeLT_iff,
    mem_nonzeroScalarSaturation_iff,
    mem_stageOneGroundIdeal_iff_exists_smul]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb, hbr⟩
    refine ⟨b, hb, ?_⟩
    rw [mem_boundedPartInDegreeLT_iff]
    simpa using hbr
  · rintro ⟨b, hb, hbr⟩
    refine ⟨b, hb, ?_⟩
    rw [mem_boundedPartInDegreeLT_iff] at hbr
    simpa using hbr

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.mem_boundedPartInDegreeLT_stageOneGroundIdeal_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_boundedPartInDegreeLT_stageOneGroundIdeal_iff
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) P)) (k : ℕ)
    (r : Polynomial.degreeLT (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) P) k) :
    r ∈ boundedPartInDegreeLT (stageOneGroundIdeal I) k ↔
      ∃ b : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) P,
        b ≠ 0 ∧ b • r ∈
          boundedPartInDegreeLT (finSuccIdeal (n := n + 1) I) k
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundedPartInDegreeLT_stageOneGroundIdeal_eq_saturation,
    mem_nonzeroScalarSaturation_iff]

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.boundedPartInDegreeLT_stageOneGroundIdeal_isGroundModule
statement:
theorem boundedPartInDegreeLT_stageOneGroundIdeal_isGroundModule
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) P)) (k : ℕ) :
    IsGroundModule (boundedPartInDegreeLT (stageOneGroundIdeal I) k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundedPartInDegreeLT_stageOneGroundIdeal_eq_saturation]
  exact nonzeroScalarSaturation_isGroundModule _

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.boundedPart_mono
statement:
theorem boundedPart_mono
    {M G : Ideal (Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) P))} (hMG : M ≤ G) :
    boundedPart M k ≤ boundedPart G k
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  exact ⟨hMG hf.1, hf.2⟩

name: MathematicalCommons.Noether.PolynomialIdealsAndResultants1923.RegularIdealDecomposition.boundedPart_le_degreeLT
statement:
theorem boundedPart_le_degreeLT
    (I : Ideal (Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) P))) :
